items.title: Trump promociona megaproyectos ante votantes que se quejan del precio de la gasolina y los alimentos
items.author: Jennifer A. Dlouhy, Josh Wingrove
items.summary: Las promesas de proyectos como una planta siderúrgica en Iowa, una fundición de aluminio en Oklahoma y un gasoducto en Alaska se enfrentan a importantes dudas e incertidumbres.
items.body: Bloomberg — Desde hace tiempo, los presidentes han hecho promesas grandilocuentes a los votantes en sus llamamientos electorales de última hora. Ver más: Carney aprovecha la guerra comercial con Trump para acelerar la transformación económica de Canadá Ahora, esa estrategia se está aplicando con toda su fuerza de cara a las elecciones de mitad de legislatura de noviembre, mientras el presidente Donald Trump recorre el país de un extremo a otro promocionando megaproyectos prometidos por valor de miles de millones de dólares en los estados clave y atribuye a su política arancelaria el mérito de haber marcado el inicio de una era dorada para la industria manufacturera nacional. Sin embargo, las promesas de una planta siderúrgica en Iowa, una fundición de aluminio en Oklahoma y un gasoducto en Alaska, tan ansiado desde hace tiempo, se enfrentan a importantes interrogantes, lo que deja sin aclarar si los proyectos se materializarán plenamente o si no serán más que un espejismo de las elecciones de mitad de mandato. Y aunque Trump apuesta fuerte por el largo plazo —aprovechando sus décadas de experiencia como promotor inmobiliario y empleando una táctica utilizada por otros gobernantes en el cargo antes de la jornada electoral—, el riesgo es que esas promesas llamativas resulten vacías para unos votantes más centrados en los gastos cotidianos y en las preocupaciones económicas inmediatas. La fundición prevista para Inola, Oklahoma, pone de relieve ese escepticismo. La empresa Century Aluminum Co., con sede en Chicago, y la empresa estatal de Dubái Emirates Global Aluminium PJSC afirman que sería la primera planta nueva de EE.UU. en casi medio siglo dedicada al procesamiento de aluminio a partir de materia prima. Trump, durante una gira de campaña la semana pasada, afirmó que sería “la mayor fábrica de aluminio, quizás, del mundo”. Pero, incluso en Oklahoma —un estado de mayoría republicana—, el proyecto se enfrenta a la oposición de los residentes, y el Consejo de Administración de Inola impuso una moratoria para bloquear la iniciativa. Century y EGA aún no han tomado una decisión definitiva sobre la inversión, ya que están solicitando propuestas para servicios de diseño de ingeniería y tratando de superar los obstáculos relacionados con la obtención de permisos. La empresa conjunta declaró en un comunicado que se sentía decepcionada por la prórroga de la moratoria impuesta por el municipio y calificó de prematura la propuesta de prohibición de la producción de aluminio. No obstante, Century también ha documentado numerosos riesgos que podrían paralizar el proyecto, reconociendo en su informe anual de 2025 que, incluso con el apoyo del Departamento de Energía, los promotores necesitan “una financiación adicional sustancial” para hacer realidad el proyecto. Algunos de los proyectos previstos ya cuentan con ayudas procedentes de los contribuyentes estatales y federales. Tómese como ejemplo la planta siderúrgica de US$15.000 millones en Iowa, un estado en el que la carrera por el Senado está muy reñida y en el que tres distritos republicanos de la Cámara de Representantes podrían cambiar de color. La planta se beneficiará del apoyo del Banco de Exportación e Importación de EE.UU., que ayudó a financiar una nueva mina en Minnesota para abastecer a la instalación —la primera de este tipo que se inaugura en más de cinco décadas—. Y la semana pasada, la gobernadora republicana de Iowa, Kim Reynolds, firmó una ley que destina hasta US$1.400 millones en incentivos fiscales para la acería. Flanqueado por republicanos de Iowa, Trump describió la planta como una consecuencia de sus políticas comerciales, insistiendo en que “todo el mundo está construyendo sus plantas aquí porque no quieren pagar aranceles”. Aunque Trump afirma que sus políticas están devolviendo la producción a EE.UU., cada uno de los proyectos requiere “alguna ayuda especial del Gobierno para poder llevarse a cabo”, señaló Douglas Holtz-Eakin, presidente del American Action Forum. “No es que la situación económica sea tan buena en todas partes como para que la gente esté construyendo cosas”. También se han planteado dudas sobre el historial de quiebras y reestructuraciones en las que se han visto implicadas unidades del Grupo Essar, el conglomerado indio que está desarrollando el complejo siderúrgico. Una filial de Essar que pretendía desarrollar una mina de taconita en Minnesota se acogió al Capítulo 11 en 2016, y una empresa siderúrgica en Canadá obtuvo protección frente a los acreedores un año antes. Minnesota también rescindió los contratos de arrendamiento de Mesabi Metallics, respaldada por Essar, tras afirmar que la empresa no había cumplido sus compromisos financieros. Por otra parte, Mesabi ha demandado a un competidor por lo que alega que es una conducta anticompetitiva, y el juicio está previsto para el próximo año. Essar ha hecho hincapié en su firme compromiso de invertir en EE.UU., asegurando en un comunicado enviado por correo electrónico que su proyecto de acería “se completará con éxito” y beneficiará tanto a Iowa como a Minnesota. “A día de hoy, todo va según lo previsto para que el proyecto se lleve a cabo, lo que lo convertirá en la mayor inversión en una planta siderúrgica de nueva construcción en Estados Unidos, gracias a esta inversión de US$18.000 millones”, afirmó la empresa. Un funcionario de la Casa Blanca señaló que el proyecto de Iowa cuenta con una sólida financiación y destacó los éxitos anteriores de Essar, entre los que se incluyen la puesta en marcha de puertos, la gestión de centrales eléctricas y la explotación de una planta de pellets de hierro en la India. Alaska también ha acaparado una mayor atención por sus ambiciosos planes de construcción. La semana pasada, Trump anunció una inversión surcoreana de US$54.000 millones destinada a un proyecto, estancado desde hace tiempo, para exportar gas natural licuado desde dicho estado. “Cerramos grandes acuerdos”, afirmó. La iniciativa para transportar gas natural desde la vertiente norte de Alaska y licuarlo para su exportación lleva décadas gestándose, frenada por su elevado coste y los retos técnicos que plantea la construcción de un gasoducto que atraviese el estado. Trump calificó el compromiso surcoreano de “irrefutable” y elogió la ayuda del senador Dan Sullivan, un republicano de Alaska que se encuentra inmerso en una reñida campaña de reelección. Horas más tarde, Corea del Sur protestó enérgicamente. El ministro de Industria, Kim Jung-kwan, afirmó que la inversión del país en el proyecto de GNL dependería de su viabilidad comercial. Se trató de una reprimenda sorprendente por parte de un aliado de EE.UU. —uno que se ha comprometido a invertir US$350.000 millones a cambio de una reducción de los aranceles sobre las exportaciones—. Y provocó la reacción de Trump, quien amenazó con imponer aranceles más elevados a los productos surcoreanos si estos se retiraban del proyecto. “El presidente Trump comenzó a aplicar una agenda económica agresiva y favorable al crecimiento desde el primer día, lo que ha supuesto y sigue suponiendo logros tangibles para el pueblo estadounidense”», afirmó el portavoz de la Casa Blanca, Taylor Rogers. “Cuenta con un historial demostrado a la hora de conseguir inversiones históricas, crear puestos de trabajo bien remunerados y recuperar la industria manufacturera para Estados Unidos”. Los estadounidenses, por su parte, están expresando una profunda preocupación por el elevado coste de la vida, lo que convierte la asequibilidad en el tema dominante de las elecciones. Aunque Trump suele hacer alarde de las ganancias en el mercado de valores, el auge de las cuentas 401(k), el aumento del empleo en general y las nuevas promesas de inversión, otros indicadores muestran una economía menos optimista. La elevada inflación llevó a la Reserva Federal a subir los tipos de interés el mes pasado y los costes del combustible se han disparado en medio de las guerras en Ucrania y Oriente Medio. Los tipos hipotecarios se encuentran en el nivel más alto del segundo mandato de Trump. El desempleo sigue siendo históricamente bajo, pero repuntó el mes pasado, y el crecimiento salarial ha sido más débil de lo que esperaban los economistas. “Están buscando a toda prisa formas de demostrar que cuentan con un programa económico sólido, por lo que van por ahí repitiendo: ‘Vienen puestos de trabajo, vienen puestos de trabajo’”, afirmó Sameera Fazili, subdirectora del Consejo Económico Nacional bajo el mandato del expresidente Joe Biden. “Por desgracia para ellos, eso no es lo que más preocupa a los votantes en esta campaña electoral”. Trump no es el único que busca impulsar su campaña electoral presentando proyectos emblemáticos. Antes de las elecciones intermedias de 2022, Biden celebró la puesta en marcha de las obras de una planta de Intel Corp ( INTC ) en Ohio. La construcción sigue en marcha, pero Intel ha retrasado su calendario. Trump también lo ha hecho antes. Antes de las elecciones de mitad de legislatura de 2018, celebró los planes de Foxconn Technology Group de construir una planta de US$10.000 millones en Wisconsin, alardeando de que sería “la octava maravilla del mundo” y crearía 15.000 puestos de trabajo. Foxconn acabó recortando su compromiso de inversión en aproximadamente un 90% y, en última instancia, solo contrató a una fracción de la plantilla prevista. Un funcionario de la Casa Blanca señaló varios anuncios de proyectos de la primera legislatura de Trump que se han llevado a cabo, entre ellos una fábrica de LG Electronics Inc en Tennessee y unas instalaciones de Samsung Electronics Co en Carolina del Sur. Trump ha reconocido los largos plazos a los que se enfrentan este tipo de proyectos. No está claro si el electorado se mostrará paciente. “Quiero que se acuerden de mí dentro de cuatro o cinco años, cuando este país esté en pleno auge”, afirmó Trump en su convención de mitad de mandato celebrada en septiembre. “Recuerden: yo soy quien lo puso en marcha”. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: Mitch Marner’s OT goal vs. Kings runs Golden Knights’ win streak to 4
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Mitch Marner scored a 4-on-3 power-play goal at 2:40 of overtime to give the Vegas Golden Knights a 2-1 victory over the Los Angeles Kings on Saturday night in Las Vegas.
items.body:
Mitch Marner scored a 4-on-3 power-play goal at 2:40 of overtime to give the Vegas Golden Knights a 2-1 victory over the Los Angeles Kings on Saturday night in Las Vegas.
With Scott Laughton in the penalty box for tripping Shea Theodore six seconds earlier, Marner snapped a wrist shot from the high slot past a screen by Mark Stone and beyond the glove of Kings goaltender Darcy Kuemper for the game-winner and his second goal of the season. It was Marner's eighth career overtime winner and his first with the Golden Knights.
Trevor Connelly scored a goal and assisted on the game-winner, while Stone had two assists for Vegas, which extended its winning streak to four games.
Carter Hart made 26 saves for the Golden Knights, who leapfrogged the Edmonton Oilers to move back into first place in the Pacific Division.
Artemi Panarin scored the lone goal for Los Angeles, which remains winless (0-2-2) under first-year head coach Peter Laviolette. The Kings also have opened a season with four consecutive losses for the first time in franchise history.
Kuemper, who led the league with 15 losses in games decided beyond regulation last season, finished with 30 saves.
Following a scoreless opening period, the teams exchanged goals in the second, which ended tied at 1 despite Vegas holding a commanding 14-3 edge in shots on goal.
The Golden Knights took a 1-0 lead at 2:37 on a power-play goal by Connelly, who one-timed a cross-crease pass from Stone inside the right post for his second goal of the season.
Los Angeles answered with a power-play goal by Panarin, who fired a shot from above the circles that sailed past a leaping screen by Alex Laferriere and caromed off the left post and in for his third goal.
The Kings, who set an NHL record last season with 33 of their 82 regular-season games reaching overtime, fell to 0-2 in games decided beyond regulation this season.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Protesters seeking India election chief's ouster detained, as 'cockroach' leaders released
items.author: Saurabh Sharma, Sarita Singh, Arpan Chaturvedi
items.creator: Saurabh Sharma, Sarita Singh, Arpan Chaturvedi
items.summary: Youth protesters, many of them from student organizations affiliated with India's communist parties, launched sporadic protests around the city on Sunday afternoon before police hauled them away in vehicles.
items.body:
Police detained hundreds of protesters in Delhi for asecond day on Sunday as sporadic protests broke out demanding India's election chief quit, and a court ordered the release of "cockroach" movement founder Abhijeet Dipke and two other senior leaders.
[USN:L1N45W01X TEXT:"Dipke"] and the other Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) leaders were detained when their plane landed in Delhi on Saturday as the movement planned to gather thousands of people at Jantar Mantar in Central Delhi.
The court ordered their release with an undertaking to "maintain public peace", the CJP said in a statement.
"Cockroaches never die," the group posted on its X account shortly after Dipke's release.
Youth protesters, many of them from students organisations affiliated with India's communist parties, launched sporadic protests around the city on Sunday afternoon before police detained them and hauled them away in vehicles.
The All India Students' Association alleged in a post on X that those detained were assaulted by police inside the vehicles.
A video posted on X by the Communist Party of India (Marxist) showed one of its lawmakers, John Brittas, being helped from a bus to an autorickshaw as he appeared to be in distress.
Reuters could not verify claims about detainees being assaulted by police.
The Delhi Police spokesperson did not respond to calls made by Reuters to seek comment.
The youth movement is one of the biggest political challenges to Prime Minister Narendra Modi in his 12 years in power, during which his Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has repeatedly swept the polls and eliminated any serious challenge by opponents, including the Congress Party.
The protesters are calling for the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner [USN:L4N45K0DB TEXT:"Gyanesh Kumar"] over a [USN:L1N45V037 TEXT:"revision of voter lists"] that critics say disproportionately benefits Modi.

items.title: Ducks stay hot, send Flames to worst start in team history
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Ryan Poehling broke a third-period tie and added an assist to pace the visiting Anaheim Ducks to a 4-2 victory over the winless Calgary Flames on Saturday.
items.body:
Ryan Poehling broke a third-period tie and added an assist to pace the visiting Anaheim Ducks to a 4-2 victory over the winless Calgary Flames on Saturday.
Frank Vatrano, Jackson LaCombe and Nikita Nesterenko also scored, and Mikael Granlund had two assists for the Ducks, who have won four of their first five games.
Goaltender Ville Husso made 27 saves in his first start of the season.
Morgan Frost and Aydar Suniev each scored, and Matt Coronato collected two assists for the Flames, who have lost their first five games in the worst start in franchise history.
Goalie Dustin Wolf stopped 24 shots for Calgary, the only NHL team without a point this season.
The score was tied 2-2 when Poehling gave the Ducks their third lead. While short-handed, he slid a shot along the ice past Wolf at 5:35 of the third period, converting on a rush.
Poehling lost his footing when Calgary defenseman Zayne Parekh slid into him, sending him crashing into the net. Poehling slammed his knee into the post. After lying on the ice for an extended period, he was helped to the dressing room and did not return.
Nesterenko provided an insurance goal with 2:57 remaining in regulation, chipping a loose puck into the net during a scramble.
Until those goals, it was an even contest, perhaps even tilted in Calgary's favor.
LaCombe opened the scoring midway through the first period, netting his first goal of the season by pouncing on a loose puck.
Frost replied five minutes later with a quick-strike tally, finishing a rush up the ice by burying an open chance from the slot.
Vatrano restored Anaheim's lead with 45 seconds remaining in the first period when he redirected a bouncing point shot into the net for his first goal of the season.
Suniev again pulled Calgary even with 2:06 remaining in the second period. The 2023 third-round draft pick converted a sharp-angle shot for his first career NHL goal in his ninth game.
The win came at a cost for the Ducks. Cutter Gauthier left the game after logging just 2:18 of ice time in the first period because of an upper-body injury and did not return.
--Field Level Media

items.author: CNA
items.summary: South Korean President President Lee Jae Myung has made Arctic shipping a priority, and officials hope to launch regular services by 2030.
items.body:

Asia

South Korea completes Arctic-Europe commercial voyage, eyes regular service despite risks

South Korean President President Lee Jae Myung has made Arctic shipping a priority, and officials hope to launch regular services by 2030.

The PanStar Acro, South Korea's first such commercial voyage to Europe via the Arctic, make its way to the port of Felixstowe, in Felixstowe, Britain on Sep 11, 2026. (File photo: Reuters/Chris Radburn)

FAST

SEOUL: A South Korean container ship completed the country's first commercial round trip to Europe via the Arctic on Sunday (Oct 11), as authorities bank on the route helping turn the port of Busan into a global maritime hub.
The PanStar Acro docked in the southeastern port 50 days after setting sail on Aug 22. Authorities say the Arctic route could cut typical voyage times by around a third.
President Lee Jae Myung has made Arctic shipping a priority, and officials hope to launch regular services by 2030.
But the project risks friction with Western allies hoping to keep Russia isolated during its war in Ukraine. The route runs along Russia's Arctic coast, and Seoul consulted with Moscow about the journey, including whether the ship needed help to tackle any problems, such as getting stuck in ice.
On its outbound voyage, the vessel passed through Arctic waters and reached its first European port, Felixstowe in Britain, before calling at Rotterdam and Gdansk and returning home via the Arctic.
The trial voyage also highlighted the challenges ahead. Before the departure, PanStar told Reuters it was seeking about 1,300 twenty-foot equivalent units of cargo, but the ship left with 737 TEU of cargo plus empty containers.
Industry experts have said the route's value will depend on reliable schedules, the costs of slowing to avoid ice, special insurance premiums and extra fuel use.

Related:

items.title: Le Népal exhorte des villageois à évacuer après une inondation provoquée par un glissement de terrain
items.author: Gopal Sharma
items.creator: Gopal Sharma
items.summary: Les autorités népalaises ont exhorté dimanche des villageois à se mettre à l'abri après que plusieurs maisons et infrastructures ont été emportées par l'importante crue d'une rivière dans le centre du pays.
items.body:
Les autorités népalaises ont exhorté dimanche des villageois à se mettre à l'abri après que plusieurs maisons et infrastructures ont été emportées par l'importante crue d'une rivière dans le centre du pays.
Un glissement de terrain survenu dans le village de Chumnubri, dans la région de Gorkha, à environ 100 kilomètres à l'ouest de Katmandou, a obstrué la rivière Budhi Gandaki, provoquant des inondations en aval, ont indiqué les autorités.
"Nous avons demandé aux villageois vivant le long des berges en aval de la rivière d'évacuer les lieux et de se mettre en sécurité", a déclaré Dharmendra Kumar Mishra, le plus haut fonctionnaire de la région de Gorkha.
Dharmendra Kumar Mishra a indiqué que plusieurs maisons et deux ponts suspendus avaient été emportés, et qu'un projet hydroélectrique avait été endommagé par les inondations.
Les autorités chargées de la gestion des catastrophes ont alerté les habitants vivant le long de la rivière dans les régions de Gorkha, Tanahun, Chitwan, Nawalparasi-Est et Nawalparasi-Ouest au sujet de cette crue.
"Veuillez vous assurer que les personnes se trouvant dans les zones à risque soient évacuées à temps vers des lieux sûrs et apportez votre aide aux opérations de recherche et de sauvetage si nécessaire", a déclaré l'Autorité nationale de gestion des catastrophes dans un message publié sur les réseaux sociaux.
Selon les responsables, des équipes de secours de l'armée et de la police ont été déployées sur place et surveillent également la situation.
Des crues dévastatrices, provoquées par l'effondrement d'un glacier dans l'Himalaya, ont fait au mois d'août 1.457 morts au Népal et des milliers de personnes sont toujours portées disparues.

items.title: India unveils steel policy aiming for 604 million tons capacity by 2047
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: India released a draft steel policy for public consultation late on Saturday, targeting 604 million metric tons of steel capacity by 2047 from around 220 million tons at present.
items.body:
India released a draft steel policy for public consultation late on Saturday, targeting 604 million metric tons of steel capacity by 2047 from around 220 million tons at present.
Reuters reported last week, citing the draft document, that the policy [USN:L4N45L0E4 TEXT:"lays out plans"] to cut sector emissions and shore up access to iron ore and coking coal — key raw materials — to meet anticipated demand.
The policy aims to cut the sector's average carbon-emission intensity to around 1.54 tons of carbon dioxide per ton of crude steel by 2047 from the current 2.54 tons, in line with India's net zero emission goal for 2070, according to the draft document.
The steel ministry expects iron ore demand at 772 million tons and plans to secure access to high-grade reserves by pursuing foreign assets and joint ventures, the document said.
The ministry also expects coking coal demand to reach 236 million tons, the document said, with the government planning to diversify its sourcing via "strategic global outreach" and acquire overseas assets.

items.title: Middle East war, high debt levels to dominate IMF-World Bank meetings in Bangkok
items.author: Andrea Shalal
items.creator: Andrea Shalal
items.summary: Finance officials from around the world will gather in Thailand this week under the shadow of a widening war in the Middle East, the biggest energy supply shock ever and rising interest rates that together pose daunting risks to already-sluggish global economic growth.
items.body:
Finance officials from around the world will gather in Thailand this week under the shadow of a widening war in the Middle East, the biggest energy supply shock ever and rising interest rates that together pose daunting risks to already-sluggish global economic growth.
The US-Israeli-led war with Iran, now in its eighth month, and the inflation and hardship it has caused, will dominate the agenda and sideline conversations during the annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank, being held outside of Washington for the first time in three years.
Notably absent will be [USN:L1N45V0KM TEXT:"US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent"], who dispatched two senior officials in his stead while he handled some "domestic engagements," a US official said.
His decision to skip the high-profile gathering and a meeting of the Group of 20 major economies, which the US leads this year, may frustrate counterparts amid rising tensions over the Iran war, Ukraine's battle against Russia's invasion and the US move to impose sanctions on the [USN:L8N45U28I TEXT:"International Criminal Court"].
World Bank President Ajay Banga told Reuters that while global growth had held up better than feared when Iran closed the Strait of Hormuz, shutting off some 20% of the world's oil, pressures were building again. Soaring prices for diesel, rising fertilizer prices and a looming [USN:L6N44V0FF TEXT:""super" El Niño weather effect"] that experts say could lead to 450,000 heat-related deaths are all hitting at once.
Group of Seven countries have agreed to [USN:B5N44301Y TEXT:"release 100 million barrels of diesel"] and crude oil from emergency reserves under pressure from US President Donald Trump, who is keen to see lower gasoline prices before November elections that could see his Republican Party lose control of Congress.
Trump on Friday announced a deal with Russia that would provide even more diesel to global markets and a temporary waiver of [USN:S0N43U024 TEXT:"US sanctions"] designed to deprive Moscow of revenues for its war on Ukraine. The move drew swift criticism from Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy.
More than 1 billion barrels of oil have been released mainly from onshore commercial inventories since the start of the war on February 28, but industry executives say the [USN:L6N45S103 TEXT:"amount of oil in storage"] that is accessible to the global market is running low, making the market more fragile and fueling pressure on prices.
Banga said the Bank was not revising down its global forecasts at the moment, but was keeping a close eye on developments. "The real thing is not just El Niño by itself; it's the combination ... What's happening to fertilizer prices? What's happening to energy costs? What's happening to debt? It's that put together that creates its own challenges," he said. "And I think that will call upon all of us to be far more careful on what we prepare for in the coming months."
RISING DEBT IMF Managing Director [USN:L1N45S0Z3 TEXT:"Kristalina Georgieva"] issued a similar warning in her traditional curtain-raiser speech previewing the meetings, telling the audience, "Winter is coming."
The IMF has signaled little change in its forecast for 3% global growth in 2026 and may edge its forecast for next year slightly higher. But some countries will see downgrades, including Ukraine, now in its fifth year of war against Russia's invasion, and Gulf countries hit by Iranian strikes and sharply reduced energy exports.
IMF research released on Tuesday showed that [USN:L1N45R02Q TEXT:"sharp spikes in food and energy prices"] are an increasingly common source of crises that drive inflation expectations higher for longer, worsen poverty and threaten economic stability.
One huge headache for policymakers is the growing public debt burden that is sapping growth and adding inflationary pressures. The IMF says public debt is at the highest level since World War Two and will exceed 100% of GDP before 2030.
Advanced economies, led by the United States, have the highest debt-to-GDP ratios, but emerging markets and low-income countries are particularly vulnerable, given a perfect storm of challenges: capital outflows in search of higher US rates, El Niño, and lack of investment in AI, which has mitigated negative supply shocks in the US and other rich countries.
EMERGING MARKET CONCERNS Developing countries are particularly vulnerable given high public debt levels that will have to be renegotiated at higher interest rates. Interest payments already exceed 10% of revenue in developing countries on average.
Early in the COVID crisis, G20 leaders announced a suspension of debt service payments for the poorest countries, but there is little appetite for such action now, according to diplomats from G20 countries, who said high debt levels and political pressures posed bigger hurdles this time.
Many lower-income countries are worried about new IMF recommendations for loan programs that call for fewer, but deeper reforms as a condition for approving lending, a change that many fear will lead to painful austerity measures.
"Countries are already cutting their expenditures because their debt payments are going high and because of the IMF conditionality," said Iolanda Fresnillo, who works on debt justice for Eurodad. "We fear that this review of conditionality policy is just going to make things worse."
Kenya, she said, had avoided a debt restructuring by cutting public expenditures and trying to raise taxes, but the changes sparked significant protests, especially by the young.
The IMF risked losing credibility unless it acknowledged the severity of the crisis facing many developing countries.
"As long as they continue with the governance structure that they have, they are becoming less and less relevant," she said.
SECURITY AND FINANCE Flight routes to Bangkok often route through the Middle East, posing immediate security challenges to the 10,000-plus travelers descending on Thailand's bustling capital city of 9 million residents following recent [USN:L1N45W03M TEXT:"attacks on Saudi airports"].
The last off-site annual meetings of the IMF and World Bank took place in Morocco just days after militants led by [USN:L8N45S0ZS TEXT:"Hamas killed 1,200 people in Israel"], followed by Israel's bombardment of Gaza that killed more than 74,000 people and devastated cities throughout the Palestinian area.
Three years later, the linkage between national security and international finance is clear, although finance officials at the time had dismissed the Hamas attack as not being an economic issue, said Josh Lipsky, vice president of international economics at the Atlantic Council.
"Obviously there have been massive global ramifications," he said. "What we're currently experiencing with Iran and the closure of the Strait of Hormuz has a direct connection with what happened three years ago."
Policymakers needed to become more agile in responding to geopolitical crises in an increasingly interconnected world, Lipsky said. "They have to be proactive and they have to recognize that they don't live in the world they used to."

items.title: New Zealand pick Allen, Ferguson, Seifert for India ODIs, Ravindra returns
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Finn Allen, Lockie Ferguson and Tim Seifert will return to New Zealand's one-day international (ODI) squad for next month's home series against India, the country's cricket board (NZC) said on Sunday.
items.body:
Finn Allen, Lockie Ferguson and Tim Seifert will return to New Zealand's one-day international (ODI) squad for next month's home series against India, the country's cricket board (NZC) said on Sunday.
Neither batter Allen nor fast bowler Ferguson have played a 50-over match for New Zealand since 2023, while Seifert's last ODI outing came in 2025.
All-rounder Rachin Ravindra, who [USN:L6N45B019 TEXT:"dislocated his right shoulder"] during a promotional shoot last month, returns to the squad after he was [USN:L6N45B019 TEXT:"ruled out of the Twenty20 series"] beginning on October 22.
"We're incredibly lucky to have the depth that we do to have 21 players involved in the series," head coach Rob Walter said in a statement.
"It's also great to bring guys like Lockie, Finn, and Tim back into the one day unit. They're all exciting and explosive players in their own right and are proven match winners."
New Zealand, who host India in five T20s, five ODIs and two tests, have named two separate squads for the first three ODIs and the final two matches.
Seven additional players will join the squad after the third ODI in Hamilton on November 10, with a portion of the group departing to begin preparations for the test series.
"With the ODI World Cup just one year away it's important for us to also view these matches as valuable preparation for that event," Walter added.
"Bringing in seven players for the final ODIs allows us to test our depth and see how those players fare against a world-class side.
"Obviously every test match is important for us in terms of championship points, which is why we're extracting some of that squad early for additional preparation before the first test."
SQUAD FOR FIRST THREE ODIS Mitchell Santner (captain), Michael Bracewell, Mark Chapman, Devon Conway, Jacob Duffy, Matt Henry, Kyle Jamieson, Tom Latham, Daryl Mitchell, Glenn Phillips, Rachin Ravindra, Nathan Smith, Will Young, Blair Tickner
SQUAD FOR FOURTH AND FIFTH ODI Mitchell Santner (captain), Finn Allen, Michael Bracewell, Mark Chapman, Kristian Clarke, Jacob Duffy, Matt Fisher, Lockie Ferguson, Mitch Hay, Nick Kelly, Tim Seifert, Blair Tickner, Will Young

items.title: サッカー＝ロナルドに暫定的な出場停止処分、代表途中離脱で
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１０日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
［１０日　ロイター］　 - ポルトガル・サッカー連盟（ＦＰＦ）は１０日、代表合宿中に突如離脱した主将クリスティアノ・ロナルド（４１）に対して懲戒手続きを開始し、暫定的に出場停止処分を科したと発表した。

ロナルドは９月３０日に、欧州ネーションズリーグの試合に向けて遠征中の代表チームから離脱した。その後公開した長文の声明で、コンディション管理のため欠場予定だったノルウェー戦での起用を巡り、ジョルジェ・ジェズス監督は「約束を破った」とコメント。同監督は記者会見で事の経緯を説明すると合意していたものの、実際に話した内容は異なっており、「監督が私との約束を破ったのはこれが２回目だった」と述べていた。

ジェズス監督は、そのような合意はなかったと否定している。

ロナルドは同じ声明の中で合宿地を突然去ったことなどを謝罪し、ＦＰＦの処分を受け入れる意向を示していた。同連盟の規定では、代表チームでの活動を「放棄」した場合は１カ月から６カ月の出場停止処分を科すことになっている。

同選手はすでに所属クラブのアルナスル（サウジアラビア）に戻っており、９日の試合でゴールを決めている。

items.title: ＭＬＢ＝Ｗソックスが地区シリーズ敗退、村上は最終戦で4三振
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１０日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
［１０日　ロイター］　 - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）は１０日、ア・リーグの地区シリーズ（５回戦制）第５戦を行い、村上宗隆内野手が所属するホワイトソックスはガーディアンズに０─２で敗戦。２連勝の後の３連敗で敗退した。

ホワイトソックスは四回に先発のショーン・バーク投手がガーディアンズの２番ホセ・ラミレス三塁手に先制２ランを打たれ、これが決勝打となった。村上は「４番・一塁」で出場し、４打数ノーヒット、４三振だった。

ガーディアンズの先発ギャビン・ウィリアムズ投手が５回２／３、１安打無失点、１２奪三振の好投で勝利投手となった。同投手は２日前に行われた第４戦では九回途中からリリーフ登板。１８球を投げてチームの勝利に貢献していた。

ＭＬＢ公式サイトによると、ポストシーズンの５回戦制のシリーズで２連敗の後、３連勝したのは２０１７年のヤンキース以来で、メジャー史上１１チーム目。

ガーディアンズは１２日から始まるア・リーグ優勝決定シリーズ（７回戦制）でレイズと対戦する。その前日に開幕するナ・リーグの同シリーズでは大谷翔平選手、山本由伸投手、佐々木朗希投手が所属するドジャースがブルワーズと戦う。

The flooded river carrying muddy sludge was rising and had washed away a highway bridge connecting Gorkha with the neighbouring Dhading district, said Dharam Raj Uprety, chief of the Authority.
National disaster authorities alerted people living along the river in the Gorkha, Tanahun, Chitwan, East Nawalparasi and West Nawalparasi districts about the flood.
"Please help ensure that people in at-risk areas are moved to safe locations in time and assist search and rescue operations as needed," the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority said in a social media post.

items.title: 韓国コンテナ船、北極海航路で初の欧州往復　定期運航へ課題も
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Joyce Lee

[ソウル １１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Joyce Lee

[ソウル １１日 ロイター] - 韓国のコンテナ船が１１日、北極海航路で欧州を往復する同国初の商業航海を終え、南東部の釜山港に帰港した。韓国政府は北極海航路の活用を進め、釜山を世界的な海運拠点に育てたい考え。

コンテナ船「パンスタ・アクロ」は８月２２日に釜山を出港し、５０日ぶりに帰港した。韓国当局によると、北極海航路なら通常のルートに比べて航海日数を約３分の１短縮できる可能性がある。李在明大統領は北極海航路の開拓を重点政策に位置付けており、政府は２０３０年までの定期運航開始を目指している。

ただ、航路はロシアの北極圏沿岸を通るため、ウクライナでの戦争を巡りロシアの孤立化を図る西側諸国との摩擦につながる可能性もある。韓国は今回の航海に先立ち、船が氷に閉じ込められた場合などの支援についてロシア側と協議した。

パンスタ・アクロは往路で北極海を通過し、欧州で最初の寄港地となる英国のフェリックストーに到着。その後、ロッテルダムとグダニスクに寄港し、再び北極海を通って帰国した。

今回の航海は商業化に向けた課題も浮き彫りになった。運航会社は出港前、約１３００ＴＥＵ（２０フィート換算のコンテナ数）の貨物確保を目指しているとロイターに説明していたが、実際に積載した貨物は７３７ＴＥＵにとどまった。

items.title: Chinese Apple supplier Luxshare sees little negative impact from US patent infringement probe
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Chinese Apple supplier Luxshare Precision Industry said it expected little negative impact from a newly launched US patent infringement investigation, and the company was actively working to respond and protect shareholder interests.
items.body:
Chinese Apple supplier Luxshare Precision Industry (002475.SZ) said it expected little negative impact from a newly launched US patent infringement investigation, and the company was actively working to respond and protect shareholder interests.
Below are the details based on Luxshare's exchange filing published late on Saturday.
Luxshare said the US International Trade Commission (ITC) on October 9 launched a Section 337 investigation into the company and its subsidiary Dongguan Luxshare Technology over patent infringement claims brought by US company Vicor Corp.
The probe, which is still in its preliminary stage, is focused on vertical power delivery systems, related components and computing systems containing them, and the ITC has not made any substantive findings, the Chinese company said.
Luxshare said the affected products — used in power modules and power supply solutions for data centres — have not entered mass production, so the investigation was unlikely to have a material adverse impact on business operations or near-term results.
Luxshare said it had begun studying the patents and products involved and was organising technical, legal and business teams to prepare a response.
Luxshare said it would strengthen cooperation with clients and supply chain partners, and actively protect the interests of the company and shareholders.

items.title: Guardians complete ALDS comeback, blank White Sox in Game 5
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: CLEVELAND -- Jose Ramirez hit a two-run homer and Gavin Williams struck out a franchise postseason-record-tying 12, leading the Cleveland Guardians to a 2-0 victory over the Chicago White Sox in the decisive Game 5 of the American League Division Series on Saturday night.
items.body:
CLEVELAND -- Jose Ramirez hit a two-run homer and Gavin Williams struck out a franchise postseason-record-tying 12, leading the Cleveland Guardians to a 2-0 victory over the Chicago White Sox in the decisive Game 5 of the American League Division Series on Saturday night.
Cleveland became the fourth team to win a best-of-five postseason series after losing the first two games at home.
Erik Sabrowski, Hunter Gaddis and Cade Smith joined Williams in a combined three-hitter for the Guardians, who will meet the Tampa Bay Rays in the AL Championship Series starting Monday in St. Petersburg, Fla.
"This was a difficult year, and for us to be one step away from the World Series, our ultimate goal, this is really exciting," Guardians manager Stephen Vogt said.
Chicago struck out 21 times, the most in major league history for a nine-inning postseason game. That broke the record of 19 the White Sox set in their Game 3 loss on Wednesday.
"We're all bummed and sad, knowing we probably should have got the job done," White Sox shortstop Colson Montgomery said after the loss.
Ramirez sent starter Sean Burke's knuckle curve 348 feet over the right-field wall, scoring Steven Kwan, who led off the fourth with the game's first hit. The 78 mph pitch was well below the strike zone, but Ramirez golfed it inside the foul pole, giving him seven RBIs over the final three games of the series.
"Jose is Jose, we all love him. He always has that one moment all the time," Williams said. "We know what he's going to do."
"Obviously, it came down to one pitch to Ramirez," Burke added. "He's a really good player. He's probably going to be in the Hall of Fame some day. But it's frustrating."
Williams (1-0) carried a no-hitter into the sixth -- two days after recording the final three outs in Game 4 -- before Kyle Teel laced a two-out single. Williams, who had hit Colson Montgomery to open the sixth, walked Miguel Vargas after Teel's hit. Sabrowski entered and struck out Munetaka Murakami to end the inning.
Williams worked 5 2/3 innings, allowing one hit and walking two. The right-hander's 24 strikeouts over three appearances were one shy of the Division Series record set by Gerrit Cole of the Houston Astros in 2019.
Williams matched the Cleveland single-game postseason record of 12 strikeouts, set by Charles Nagy in the 1996 ALDS against the Baltimore Orioles. Williams owns two of the five double-digit strikeout performances in team playoff history.
"It's pretty satisfying," Williams said. "No matter what point (of the postseason) it is, it's always fun. And just being able to celebrate with the guys, it's a dream come true."
Burke (1-1) allowed two runs on four hits over five innings, striking out four.
Smith, who pitched the final 1 2/3 innings for his first save of the postseason, and Gaddis appeared in all five games.
"Our back end of the bullpen has been the lifeblood of this team since I've been here," Vogt said. "They have the highest leverage. They have the toughest outs to get. And Eric came in, you just felt like he was going to do what he did."
--Brian Dulik, Field Level Media

items.title: River Plate vence a Estudiantes de Río Cuarto, que sella su descenso en liga argentina
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: River Plate volvió al triunfo el sábado al vencer 1-0 como local a Estudiantes de Río Cuarto, que selló su descenso a la segunda división del fútbol argentino.
items.body:
River Plate volvió al triunfo el sábado al vencer 1-0 como local a Estudiantes de Río Cuarto, que selló su descenso a la segunda división del fútbol argentino.
Con la victoria en la duodécima jornada del Torneo Clausura, River llegó a 16 puntos y se ubicó novenol en la tabla de posiciones de la Zona B, a dos unidades de los ocho puestos de clasificación a la postemporada.
En el partido disputado en el estadio Monumental ante 85.000 aficionados, el gol lo anotó el defensor Marcos Acuña a los seis minutos de juego, tras un centro de Ángel Correa.
"Fue una victoria importante. El equipo jugó un buen partido y logramos el triunfo, aunque no pudimos ampliar la diferencia y cerrar el partido", dijo el delantero Lautaro Pereyra a la televisión local.
Por su parte, a falta de cuatro fechas para el final de la fase regular, Estudiantes se convirtió en el primer equipo en confirmar el descenso tras una campaña con dos victorias, cinco empates y 21 derrotas.
"Peleamos todo el año, pero nunca pudimos hacer pie. Errores, mala suerte, y termina pasando lo que no queríamos un par de fechas antes", dijo el defensor de Estudiantes Gonzalo Maffini tras la derrota.
En otros partidos del sábado, Barracas Central superó 2-0 como local a Huracán y Banfield ganó 2-1 en su visita a Tigre, mientras que Central Córdoba y Estudiantes de La Plata igualaron 2-2.
El viernes, Boca Juniors igualó 2-2 ante Instituto de Córdoba, Defensa y Justicia venció 2-0 a Unión y Sarmiento superó 3-1 a Aldosivi, en tanto que Gimnasia y Esgrima La Plata y Atlético Tucumán empataron 1-1.

GENEVA: The World Health Organization (WHO) said on Saturday (Oct 10) that it still does not know what caused the pneumonia that killed a Russian lab worker at an anti-plague research centre in Siberia this month, and that no case of plague had been registered.
The WHO said the Russian state regulator reported that tests of the lab worker and those who came in contact with her were negative for the high-threat pathogens tested, that her contacts still showed no symptoms, and that no further linked cases of severe pneumonia had been identified.
"Based on the information provided ... (the) WHO has not identified evidence of ongoing transmission associated with this event. A key uncertainty remains the absence of a confirmed diagnosis in the deceased laboratory worker," it said in a statement.
The lab worker fell ill and died in undisclosed circumstances on Oct 2, prompting authorities to quarantine about 200 people and causing public health fears on social media.
Global health officials have been extra alert to fatal pneumonia cases of undetermined cause since the COVID-19 pandemic, which began with a cluster of fast-spreading fatal respiratory illness in China. The cause of individual pneumonia cases can often not be determined.
Russian authorities have said the lab worker was appropriately vaccinated and that they found no microorganisms linked to her work in her body.
On Thursday, Russia said it had completed health checks on all the worker's contacts. It says it had provided full information to the WHO according to established procedures.

items.summary: Market investors will also watch foreign investor trading activity, rupee movement, US Treasury yields, and geopolitical developments ...
items.body:
Home / Markets / News / Q2 earnings, inflation data, oil prices may drive stock markets this week

Q2 earnings, inflation data, oil prices may drive stock markets this week Market investors will also watch foreign investor trading activity, rupee movement, US Treasury yields, and geopolitical developments

Last week, the BSE benchmark Sensex jumped 562.63 points, or 0.78 per cent, and the NSE Nifty was up 98.5 points, or 0.43 per cent | Image: Bloomberg

Press Trust of India New Delhi 3 min read Last Updated : Oct 11 2026 | 3:18 PM IST

Listen to This Article

Major quarterly earnings from companies like Wipro and HCL Tech, along with inflation figures, global trends, and crude oil price movements, will drive stock market movement this week, analysts said.
Market investors will also watch foreign investor trading activity, rupee movement, US Treasury yields, and geopolitical developments.
"September CPI inflation will be the first major domestic test this week. A stronger-than-expected reading could revive concerns over further RBI tightening, putting rate-sensitive sectors such as banking, automobiles and real estate under pressure while raising the risk of a broader drag on consumer demand.
"A softer print could ease concerns over the eventual peak in interest rates, but any relief may prove short-lived if Brent crude remains above USD 100 a barrel. Wholesale price inflation data will offer a further indication of how elevated energy and logistics costs are filtering through to producer prices," Hariselvan Radhakrishnan, Founder & CEO of HST Wealth, a research analyst firm, said.
 

US inflation and retail sales data will influence Treasury yields and the dollar, he said.
Also Read

Nifty lags global peers as Korea, Taiwan markets surge on AI boom

Datanomics: BSE took a decade to enter the Nifty 50; any lessons for NSE? premium

Sensex snaps 8-week losing run; but can gains last? Experts weigh in

KEC Int'l: Why Kotak upgraded stock to 'Add' despite 60% fall in a year

Stocks to watch: TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Anand Rathi, KEC Int'l, NCC, BEML

"The IT sector will remain in focus as HCL Technologies, Wipro and Tech Mahindra report their September quarter results. The sector staged a sharp rebound on Friday following TCS's better-than-expected earnings, but whether the recovery gains traction will depend on the performance of its peers and their outlook for the coming quarters," Radhakrishnan added.
IT stocks emerged as major catalysts behind the market's sharp recovery on Friday, following an over 4 per cent rally in TCS after it reported better-than-expected September quarter results.
Indian IT companies largely brushed aside the news regarding the US suspending eight IT firms, including TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant and Microsoft, from a programme that allowed applications for green cards for foreign workers, contending that the practice has shut out Americans from the job market.

TCS on Friday said it does not expect the US action on the green card programme to affect its workforce strategy or customer engagements, as India's largest IT services company cited its single-digit applications under the programme over the past two years and its focus on local hiring.
Forthcoming results this week are from BHEL, Canara Bank, HDB Financial Services, HDFC Asset Management Company and Nestle.
"Indian equities are expected to consolidate this week as markets balance improving domestic earnings momentum against elevated global risks. Brent crude remains above USD 100 per barrel and sustained FII selling continues to weigh on sentiment. After eight consecutive weeks of declines, the Nifty-50 gained 0.4 per cent last week, suggesting some stabilisation at lower levels, although the broader market is likely to remain selective," Siddhartha Khemka - Head of Research, Wealth Management, Motilal Oswal Financial Services Ltd, said.

Domestically, September CPI and WPI inflation data will be closely tracked for signs of further price pressures, while the 2QFY27 earnings season gathers pace, he said.
"Key global data points include US CPI and jobs data, EU CPI and UK GDP," Khemka added.
Last week, the BSE benchmark Sensex jumped 562.63 points, or 0.78 per cent, and the NSE Nifty was up 98.5 points, or 0.43 per cent.
"Corporate earnings will increasingly influence sector-level performance as the September quarter results season gathers pace. TCS's results helped trigger a rebound across IT stocks, supporting the broader indices on Friday. Crude oil remains the biggest macroeconomic risk. Uncertainty over Iran, the Strait of Hormuz and regional energy infrastructure continues to leave global supply vulnerable to disruption," Ponmudi R, CEO - Enrich Money, an online trading and wealth tech firm, said.

items.title: トランプ氏、ウクライナ大統領の交代求める　軽油高騰でロシア製油所攻撃を批判
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Max Hunder　Steve Holland

[１０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Max Hunder　Steve Holland

[１０日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１０日、「ウクライナは新しい大統領を選ぶときだと思う」と述べ、ゼレンスキー大統領の交代を求めた。ウクライナによるロシアの製油所への攻撃が世界の軽油供給に打撃を与えていると批判した。

トランプ氏は前日、ロシアから軽油を輸入することで合意したと発表。ゼレンスキー氏は、合意がロシアを勢いづかせたと強く反発した。

米国とイスラエルが２月にイランを攻撃して以降、世界的に軽油価格が急騰しており、来月の米中間選挙を控えてトランプ氏の共和党にとって政治的な重荷となっている。選挙では野党・民主党が上下両院の一方、または両方で多数派を奪還する可能性がある。

トランプ氏が軽油供給合意を発表したのは、ウクライナと欧州の当局者が９日に米マイアミで米側と戦争終結に向けた共通案を協議している最中だった。ゼレンスキー氏によると、発表はウクライナ側にとって予想外だった。

英国のバーナム首相は１０日、ゼレンスキー氏と電話会談し、対ロシア制裁を強化する考えを伝えた。英首相官邸が明らかにした。両首脳は数日中に直接会談する予定という。

items.title: L'armée américaine met hors d'usage un navire dans le golfe d'Oman
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: L'armée américaine a déclaré samedi avoir mis hors d'usage un navire commercial dans le Golfe d'Oman après que l'équipage, ignorant des avertissements, a tenté de forcer le blocus naval imposé par les Etats-Unis contre l'Iran.
items.body:
L'armée américaine a déclaré samedi avoir mis hors d'usage un navire commercial dans le Golfe d'Oman après que l'équipage, ignorant des avertissements, a tenté de forcer le blocus naval imposé par les Etats-Unis contre l'Iran.
"Un avion de chasse de l'armée américaine a frappé la poupe du M/V Ocean Molica (également connu sous le nom d''Arika Sun'), battant pavillon panaméen, à l'aide d'une munition à guidage de précision, rendant ainsi le système de propulsion du navire totalement hors d'usage, sans blesser l'équipage", a indiqué le commandement central de l'armée américaine (Centcom) sur le réseau social X.
Le Centcom a indiqué que le navire avait tenté de traverser les eaux régionales après avoir quitté un port iranien.

items.title: Canadiens blank Red Wings in rare 1-0 shootout victory
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Zack Bolduc scored the only goal of a shootout that went three extra rounds to give the host Montreal Canadiens a 1-0 win over the Detroit Red Wings on Saturday night.
items.body:
Zack Bolduc scored the only goal of a shootout that went three extra rounds to give the host Montreal Canadiens a 1-0 win over the Detroit Red Wings on Saturday night.
Jacob Fowler made 30 saves in regulation and overtime for the Canadiens, who snapped their three-game losing streak (0-2-1).
Daniil Tarasov also stopped 30 shots in the first 65 minutes for the Red Wings, who dropped their second in two nights (0-1-1).
It was the second career shutout for both goaltenders.
The Canadiens had three goals called back.
Alexandre Texier's apparent overtime winner 2:37 into the extra period was overturned by an offside challenge from Detroit coach Todd McLellan. Bolduc was offside.
An apparent goal by Cole Caufield 1:16 into the game was reversed by video review because the puck did not completely cross the goal line.
Bolduc put the puck into the net 7:05 into the second period, but the goal was immediately waved off because of goalie interference by Jake Evans.
There were chants from the Montreal crowd of "We want Larkin" at times when the Red Wings' Dylan Larkin was on the ice, but booed him during his shootout attempt, which was stopped by Fowler. It was first reported on June 4, that Larkin asked to be traded and was removed as the team's captain at the beginning of training camp.
Bolduc hit the goal post with 8:07 left in the first period.
Fowler made a big save on Alex DeBrincat's wide-open backhand attempt from just below the left circle with a little less than five minutes remaining in the second period and stopped Andrew Copp on a breakaway attempt 3:37 into the third.
Tarasov denied a shot that deflected off of Caufield just outside the crease at the 6:09 mark of the third period.
Montreal defenseman Kaiden Guhle made his season debut after undergoing adductor muscle surgery over the summer.
--Field Level

items.title: Brandon Hagel (hat trick), Lightning down Islanders for 4th straight win
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Tampa Bay's Brandon Hagel ripped a tiebreaking goal with 1:44 remaining and completed his fourth career hat trick with an empty-netter as the Lightning claimed their fourth straight victory, beating the host New York Islanders 5-3 on Saturday night.
items.body:
Tampa Bay's Brandon Hagel ripped a tiebreaking goal with 1:44 remaining and completed his fourth career hat trick with an empty-netter as the Lightning claimed their fourth straight victory, beating the host New York Islanders 5-3 on Saturday night.
Tied 3-all, Hagel rifled a shot past Ilya Sorokin (21 saves) with a long wrister for his second goal and added his third into an empty net as Tampa Bay won the first of its two-game set in New York. He added an assist for a four-point night.
Jake Guentzel tallied twice, and Nikita Kucherov and Max Crozier each had two assists. Goaltender Andrei Vasilevskiy stopped 20 shots.
Defenseman Tony DeAngelo recorded a goal and an assist, and Jean-Gabriel Pageau and Brayden Schenn scored as the Islanders lost for the first time in three games on home ice this season.
New York forward Matias Maccelli had his 121st career assist in his 300th NHL game.
A turnover led to the first goal as Pageau flipped a puck from the end boards out near the right circle in his defensive end. Guentzel gained possession and sent in an unassisted tally at 5:45 of the first period.
Vasilevskiy kept the Islanders off the scoreboard by denying Bo Horvat on a breakaway after Tampa Bay defenseman Victor Hedman gave away the puck. Horvat fired a shot on the 1-on-1 try, but the Vezina Trophy winner turned it away at 11:14.
A 36-goal scorer last season, Hagel watched Hedman backhand a long flip down the ice and used his speed to run it down. He beat defenseman Ryan Pulock to the puck and tallied at 15:42 for a two-goal lead through the opening period.
Despite being banged up, New York's blue line put the club on the board in the second period when DeAngelo took a feed from Ondrej Palat and fired home his first goal from the deep slot at 6:27.
Guentzel netted his second with his team on the power play. Kucherov found him to the left of Sorokin, and the winger made an inside move and beat the goalie for his third marker at 7:54 for a 3-1 advantage.
Pageau made up for his earlier miscue to cut the Islanders' deficit to 3-2 at 11:41 of the second period. On Schaefer's deep shot, Pageau tipped it past Vasilevskiy.
In the final moments of the second, Horvat helped tie it when his pass through the crease went in around a tangle of players near Vasilevskiy while the Islanders were on a power play. Schenn was credited with his second score of the season.
Hagel broke the tie with 1:44 remaining in regulation, then completed his hat trick with an empty-net goal 21 seconds later to seal the victory.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Senators rally from early 2-goal deficit, beat Predators in shootout
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Shane Pinto beat Matt Murray in the third round of the shootout as the Ottawa Senators rallied for a 3-2 win over the visiting Nashville Predators on Saturday.
items.body:
Shane Pinto beat Matt Murray in the third round of the shootout as the Ottawa Senators rallied for a 3-2 win over the visiting Nashville Predators on Saturday.
Tim Stutzle had a goal and an assist in regulation and scored in the second round of the shootout. Drake Batherson also scored for the Senators, while Ottawa goaltender Linus Ullmark stopped 16 shots.
Ross Colton and Jonathan Marchessault scored first-period goals, and Ryan O'Reilly had a shootout goal for Nashville.
Murray recorded 18 saves in his first start since the 2023-24 season, when he played for the Dallas Stars.
Ullmark saved Steven Stamkos' final shootout attempt to secure the win.
Earlier in the third, with an extra attacker on the ice, Stutzle's shot deflected off Pinto and ricocheted off Batherson's shin to tie the game at 2-2 at 18:37.
The Predators struck first at 8:50 of the opening period when a loose puck emerged from a crowd near the left circle. Colton collected it and snapped a quick shot past Ullmark into the top-right corner of the net.
Marchessault doubled Nashville's lead on the power play at 13:10. Taking a pass from Stamkos just below the left circle, Marchessault turned and fired, slipping a shot between Ullmark's stick and the post to make it 2-0.
Ottawa cut its deficit to 2-1 on a power-play goal at 9:29 of the second period. Dylan Cozens slid a cross-ice pass to Stutzle, who rifled a one-timer into the net.
Murray gloved Cozens' shot at 13:40 of the second period. Moments later, Thomas Chabot's wrist shot through traffic rang off the left post.
Later in the second period, the Predators killed off Ottawa's 5-on-3 advantage.
The Predators killed off a power play to open overtime, and as Roman Josi emerged from the penalty box, he collected a rebound at center ice and skated in alone on Ullmark, who turned aside his shot.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Rickard Rakell lifts Penguins over Stars with shootout winner
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Rickard Rakell scored the shootout winner in the fourth round and the Penguins beat the Dallas Stars 2-1 Saturday night in Pittsburgh.
items.body:
Rickard Rakell scored the shootout winner in the fourth round and the Penguins beat the Dallas Stars 2-1 Saturday night in Pittsburgh.
Dallas forced overtime when Tyler Seguin tied it 1-1 with 30 seconds left in regulation after Roope Hintz won a faceoff and Seguin deflected Jason Robertson's shot past Arturs Silovs.
Ben Kindel and Sidney Crosby also tallied in the shootout for the Penguins while Seguin and Wyatt Johnston scored for Dallas. After Rakell's goal put Pittsburgh up, Silovs deflected Mikko Rantanen's shot to end it.
Connor Dewar scored his first goal of the season for the Penguins, who were playing the second of a back-to-back and had lost three straight (0-2-1). Silovs made 24 saves.
Jake Oettinger made 19 saves for Dallas, which had won two straight.
Oettinger, who came in with consecutive shutouts, saw his shutout streak end at 188:52, the third longest in franchise history.
Crosby is still looking for his first regulation goal six games into the season.
Pittsburgh was 0-for-5 on the power play; Dallas was 0-for-3.
The Penguins appeared to take a 1-0 lead late in the first period when Stars forward Justin Hryckowian tapped a loose puck into his own net during a scramble in front. But it was ruled that Pittsburgh's Hendrix Lapierre used a high stick earlier in the sequence.
Silovs robbed Seguin with his left pad with 4:25 remaining in the second period to keep the game scoreless.
Oettinger made a superb glove save against Crosby in the slot in the opening minute of the third period.
Dewar made It 1-0 at 1:57 of the third period. He carried the puck into the zone along the left boards, cut across the slot and lifted a backhand that deflected off Dallas defenseman Lian Bichsel's stick and over Oettinger's right shoulder.
Oettinger made a pair of saves on Evgeni Malkin in the final minute of overtime.
--Field Level Media

items.title: サッカー＝バルセロナ快勝で開幕からの連勝キープ、レアルは辛勝
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［マドリード　１０日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
［マドリード　１０日　ロイター］　 - サッカーのスペイン１部は１０日、各地で試合を行い、昨季王者で首位のバルセロナがヘタフェを３─０で下し、開幕から８連勝とした。

バルセロナは前半２分、アンソニー・ゴードンの放ったシュートが相手選手に当たってコースが変わり、ネットを揺らして先制に成功。同３０分にはこの日が新天地での初先発となったガブリエル・ジェズスが加点し、最後はジュール・クンデのゴールで締めくくった。

レアル・マドリードはビリャレアルに１─０で辛勝。後半１７分に１９歳のヤン・ディオマンデがオフサイドトラップをかいくぐって挙げたゴールが決勝点となった。今夏に加入した同選手にとって、これがレアルでの初ゴール。

レアルはその８分後、ビニシウス・ジュニオールがネットを揺らすも、ビデオ・アシスタント・レフェリー（ＶＡＲ）の介入により、ゴール前に相手選手の髪を引っ張っていたとしてノーゴール判定に。さらにジュニオールは一発退場となった。

その他、アトレチコ・マドリードはアラベスに２─１で勝利。ラヨ・バリェカノ─ビルバオの一戦は、スタジアムでラヨのファンがクラブオーナーへの抗議としてピッチに物を投げ込むなどし、１５分間の中断の後に中止となった。

items.title: 米司法省、独禁法違反の疑いでテレビ5社調査　ホワイトハウス取材停止巡り
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
[ワシントン １０日 ロイター] - 米司法省は３日、ＡＢＣ、ＣＢＳ、ＣＮＮ、ＮＢＣ、ＦＯＸのテレビ局５社を反トラスト法（独占禁止法）違反の疑いで調査していると明らかにした。ＣＮＮなど３社の記者証を取り消したホワイトハウスに抗議し、各局が代表取材をボイコットしたことを受けた措置。

司法省の報道官は「ライバル企業同士が集団でボイコットすることは、シャーマン法に違反する可能性がある」と指摘。「反トラスト局は、これらの報道機関が反トラスト法に違反したかどうかを判断するため調査しているにすぎない」と述べた。

トランプ政権と主要報道機関の対立が相次ぐ中、今回の調査は新たな火種となる。トランプ大統領は主要メディアを繰り返し「フェイクニュース」と呼び、記者とのやり取りで衝突することも多い。

各社からコメントは得られていない。

司法省の報道官は「ライバル企業同士が集団でボイコットすることは、シャーマン法に違反する可能性がある」と指摘。「反トラスト局は、これらの報道機関が反トラスト法に違反したかどうかを判断するため調査しているにすぎない」と述べた。

トランプ政権と主要報道機関の対立が相次ぐ中、今回の調査は新たな火種となる。トランプ大統領は主要メディアを繰り返し「フェイクニュース」と呼び、記者とのやり取りで衝突することも多い。

各社からコメントは得られていない。

ホワイトハウスは９月１９日、ＣＮＮ、ポリティコ、ＭＳ ＮＯＷの記者証を取り消し、記者のホワイトハウスへの立ち入りを禁止した。ホワイトハウスは、大統領を取材することは「権利ではなく特権だ」と主張した。

これに対し３社は、取材排除は憲法修正第１条に違反し、報道内容への報復措置だとして政権を提訴。ホワイトハウスを取材する主要テレビ５社は連帯して取材を停止した。

items.title: Canadian ransomware negotiator arrested amid FBI hacker crackdown
items.author: Raphael Satter, A.J. Vicens
items.creator: Raphael Satter, A.J. Vicens
items.summary: A Canadian ransomware negotiator was arrested Thursday and faces unspecified extortion charges, according to court documents, prison records and a person familiar with the matter, as the FBI cracks down on a hacking group that stole information about its employees.
items.body:
A Canadian ransomware negotiator was arrested Thursday and faces unspecified extortion charges, according to court documents, prison records and a person familiar with the matter, as the FBI cracks down on a hacking group that stole information about its employees.
Edward Dubrovsky faces charges of conspiracy to "threaten to impair the confidentiality of information with intent to extort money" and "interference with commerce," according to court documents filed with the Eastern District of Pennsylvania, which covers Philadelphia.
The records, which are partially sealed, provide conflicting spellings of his last name — "Dobrovsky" or "Dobrosky" — and do not identify his age, profession, or employer. A person briefed on the matter said the person was Canadian cybersecurity executive Edward Dubrovsky.
Federal prosecutors in Philadelphia did not return repeated messages seeking comment about the discrepancies. Attempts to reach Dubrovsky and his attorneys were unsuccessful. Repeated attempts to reach the company displayed on Dubrovsky's LinkedIn profile, CyberSteward, were similarly unsuccessful.
CyberSteward advertises itself online as specializing in "threat actor engagement, cyber-extortions, complex negotiations, and settlement facilitation." On LinkedIn, Dubrovsky presents himself as a specialist in the process of negotiating with cybercriminals over ransom payments.
Electronic wallet records leaked in 2010 and preserved by dark-web intelligence firm District 4 Labs identify Dubrovsky as a resident of Richmond Hill, north of Toronto, and put his current age at 54. Federal prison records show that a 54-year-old named Edward Dubrovsky is currently being detained at a federal detention center in Philadelphia.
News of Dubrovsky's arrest was earlier reported by Politico and independent journalist Brian Krebs .
The arrest comes as the Federal Bureau of Investigation is leading a global crackdown on the hacking group ShinyHunters, which rattled the bureau last month by stealing information on what it said was [USN:L6N45E0VU TEXT:"nearly every FBI employee"].
When Reuters asked the FBI about Dubrovsky's arrest, it referred the news agency to FBI Director Kash Patel's [USN:L6N45V0R8 TEXT:"statement on Friday"] revealing that the bureau had arrested a "suspected co-conspirator of the ShinyHunters group" and declined further comment.

items.title: William Nylander (5 points) propels Maple Leafs past Avalanche
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: William Nylander had two goals and three assists, Auston Matthews had two goals and two assists, and the Toronto Maple Leafs beat the Colorado Avalanche 6-3 in Denver on Saturday night.
items.body:
William Nylander had two goals and three assists, Auston Matthews had two goals and two assists, and the Toronto Maple Leafs beat the Colorado Avalanche 6-3 in Denver on Saturday night.
Nylander's three assists and five points matched his career highs.
Easton Cowan and Nick Blankenburg also scored, Nick Paul had two assists and Sergei Bobrovsky turned away 30 shots for Toronto. The Maple Leafs have split the first two games of their three-game road trip.
Nathan MacKinnon had two goals, Brock Nelson also scored and Mackenzie Blackwood had 17 saves for Colorado. The Avalanche lost for the first time in three home games this season.
Blankenburg gave Toronto the early advantage when he scored from close range at 3:03 of the first period, but MacKinnon asserted himself the rest of the period.
He took a pass from Brett Kulak in the neutral zone, skated through the Maple Leafs defense and slid the puck through Bobrovsky's pads at 10:46 to tie it. MacKinnon gave Colorado a 2-1 lead later in the period when his screened shot from between the faceoff circles beat Bobrovsky high to the stick side at 15:14.
The Avalanche had a chance to extend the lead with consecutive power plays at the start of the second but couldn't score. Toronto took advantage of its first power-play chance when Nylander got a pass from Gavin McKenna to the right of Blackwood, deked the goaltender and tucked the puck on the opposite side at 6:53.
Colorado took a 3-2 lead later in the second when Nelson cleaned up his own rebound and fluttered a shot over Bobrovsky at 12:25, but the Maple Leafs responded twice in less than a minute.
Nylander's second of the night, at 16:47, tied the game, and Cowan made it 4-3 with a one-timer on a pass from Morgan Rielly at 17:33.
Matthews scored a power-play goal at 12:02 of the third period and added an empty-netter in the final minute after Blackwood came off for an extra skater.
--Field Level Media
items.raw_description: William Nylander had two goals and three assists, Auston Matthews had two goals and two assists, and the Toronto Maple Leafs beat the Colorado Avalanche 6-3 in Denver on Saturday night.

items.title: Blues snap 3-game skid, score season-high 5 goals to edge Blue Jackets
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Jimmy Snuggerud scored two second-period goals in quick succession and Jonatan Berggren scored the game-winning goal to help the St. Louis Blues halt their three-game slide with a 5-3 home victory over the Columbus Blue Jackets on Saturday.
items.body:
Jimmy Snuggerud scored two second-period goals in quick succession and Jonatan Berggren scored the game-winning goal to help the St. Louis Blues halt their three-game slide with a 5-3 home victory over the Columbus Blue Jackets on Saturday.
The Blues entered the matchup buried in offensive woes during their three-game losing skid, but found their flow as Jake Neighbours and Pavel Buchnevich also found the back of the net and Dylan Holloway picked up three assists.
Jordan Binnington made 20 saves as he recorded his first victory of the season.
Cole Sillinger, Kent Johnson, and Valeri Nichushkin lit the lamp for the Blue Jackets, while Jet Greaves finished with 22 saves.
With a delayed penalty forthcoming, Berggren went hard to the front of the net and found a loose puck to score the eventual game-winning goal with just over 10 minutes remaining.
After a quiet start to the contest, the Blue Jackets broke the deadlock with 3:50 left in the first period as Erik Gudbranson sent a pass that redirected off the side of the net and Sean Monahan's shot banked in off Nichushkin for his first goal as a Blue Jacket.
Johnson doubled up the lead with 12 seconds left in the opening frame as he cut into the middle and wired a shot off the far post and past Binnington.
Neighbours made it a one-goal game with 13:50 remaining in the middle frame as he found the puck near the Blue Jackets' net and fired it home.
Snuggerud knotted things up just under three minutes later as Philip Broberg carried the puck in wide and slid a pass across that hit the young forward's skate and bounced in.
The 2022 first-round pick kept it rolling with his second of the night with 7:28 left in the second as he patiently waited and then perfectly placed a shot under the blocker of Greaves.
Sillinger took advantage of some poor rebound control from Binnington to tie the game back up with 13:09 left in the third period.
Buchnevich put the game to rest with an empty-net goal.
Each team only had one power-play chance on the night and neither was successful.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Big second period propels Hurricanes past Blackhawks
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Jackson Blake and Jordan Martinook both scored once and added an assist, and the visiting Carolina Hurricanes used a three-goal second period to beat the slumping Chicago Blackhawks 5-2 on Saturday night.
items.body:
Jackson Blake and Jordan Martinook both scored once and added an assist, and the visiting Carolina Hurricanes used a three-goal second period to beat the slumping Chicago Blackhawks 5-2 on Saturday night.
Mark Jankowski, Sebastian Aho and Taylor Hall also scored for the Hurricanes, who have won four straight games.
All four Carolina forward lines lit the lamp.
Goaltender Brandon Bussi made 24 saves and Mike Reilly collected two assists.
Roman Kantserov, with his first NHL goal, and Oliver Moore replied for the Blackhawks, while goalie Spencer Knight made 34 saves. Chicago has just one win in six games to start the season.
After dominating play from the drop of the puck, the Hurricanes finally pulled ahead when Jankowski converted a breakaway with 56.2 seconds remaining in the first period. He has scored in three consecutive games for the first time in his 11-year NHL career.
That tally sparked the defending Stanley Cup champions. Aho doubled the lead when he buried a shot from the slot after neatly eluding a check at 2:09 of the second period. Blake gave the visitors a three-goal lead 79 seconds later by converting from the doorstep for his first goal of the season.
Kantserov provided the Blackhawks a boost when he tallied on a breakaway for his milestone marker, a huge boost for the 2023 second-round draft pick, at 4:40 of the middle frame.
However, Hall restored Carolina's three-goal lead 85 seconds later by unloading a one-timer from the high slot. Martinook extended the edge with his first of the season, a backhanded shot from the slot at 5:00 of the third period.
Moore rounded out the scoring with less than six minutes remaining.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Kipchoge wins first marathon in three years in Melbourne
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Kenya's twice Olympic champion Eliud Kipchoge won the Melbourne Marathon in a course record of 2 hours, 9 minutes and 10 seconds on Sunday, claiming his 17th win over the distance at age 41.
items.body:
Kenya's twice Olympic champion Eliud Kipchoge won the Melbourne Marathon in a course record of 2 hours, 9 minutes and 10 seconds on Sunday, claiming his 17th win over the distance at age 41.
Kipchoge is attempting to run a marathon on all seven continents over two years, having launched his continental campaign at the Cape Town Marathon [USN:L1N3ZX0XB TEXT:"in May"].
Sunday's win was his first in three years, after he won Berlin in 2023 for [USN:L2N3VP0S3 TEXT:"a record"] 11th title at the majors.
"I believe that my body is still peaking – still able to compete with the next generation," Kipchoge told reporters after the race.
"The oldest athlete is still competing but I am happy to run with the Gen Zs. I (increased) the pace after 30 km, to see whether I can run well and beat the (race record). My plan went well."
Australian Thomas Do Canto finished second behind Kipchoge at 2:10:35, while compatriot Reece Edwards was third at 2:14:33.
New Zealand's Camille French won the women's race in 2:28:25, followed by Australian Sinead Diver at 2:28:49 and Nichola Sheridan of Ireland at 2:29:13.

items.title: テニス＝マスターズ上海大会、第2シードのアルカラス3回戦進出
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１０日　ロイター］ - テニスのマスターズ上海大会は１０日、男子シングルス２回戦を行い、第２シードのカルロス・アルカラス（スペイン）が３回戦に進んだ。

アルカラスはフアンマヌエル・セルンドロ（アルゼンチン）に６─３、６─３で快勝。８本のサービスエースを放ち、ブレークポイントは１回も握られなかった。ウィナーの本数でも２４─８と上回り、わずか６７分で勝利を収めた。

スペイン人男子による同大会初優勝を目指すアルカラスは、次戦でジズー・ベルグス（ベルギー）と対戦する。ベルグスは２回戦で第３２シードのイグナシオ・ブセ（ペルー）を６─０、６─３で下した。

第４シードのフェリックス・オジェアリアシム（カナダ）、ロシア出身で第５シードのダニル・メドベージェフはともにフルセットで勝ち上がり。第８シードのアルトゥール・フィス（フランス）、第１１シードのテーラー・フリッツ（米国）らも勝ち上がった。

items.title: Ｆ１＝シンガポールＧＰ予選、フェルスタッペンがＰＰ獲得
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［シンガポール　１０日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
［シンガポール　１０日　ロイター］　 - 自動車レースＦ１の第１７戦、シンガポール・グランプリ（ＧＰ）は１０日、予選を行い、マックス・フェルスタッペン（オランダ、レッドブル）が２戦連続、キャリア通算５０回目のポールポジション（ＰＰ）を獲得した。

４回の個人総合優勝を誇るフェルスタッペンにとって、今回がＦ１での通算２５０戦目。シャルル・ルクレール（モナコ）が２番手、ルイス・ハミルトン（英国）が３番手とフェラーリ勢が続き、総合首位のキミ・アントネッリ（イタリア、メルセデス）が４番手だった。

昨季の総合王者ランド・ノリス（英国、マクラーレン）は５番手。総合２位のジョージ・ラッセル（英国、メルセデス）は６番手だったが、エンジンのペナルティーにより、決勝では最後尾からのスタートとなる。ノリスの同僚、オスカー・ピアストリ（オーストラリア）は７番手のタイムを計測した。

予選の前に行われたスプリントではフェルスタッペンが勝利。ハミルトンが２位、ルクレールが３位、アントネッリが４位だった。ノリスとピアストリが接触したが、ともにペナルティーは受けなかった。

items.title: US military says it disabled cargo vessel trying to run Iran blockade
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The US military said on Saturday it had disabled a commercial cargo vessel in the Gulf of Oman after the ship's crew ignored warnings and attempted to run a naval blockade against Iran.
items.body:
The US military said on Saturday it had disabled a commercial cargo vessel in the Gulf of Oman after the ship's crew ignored warnings and attempted to run a naval blockade against Iran.
"A U.S. military fighter jet struck the stern of Panama-flagged M/V Ocean Molica (also known as the “Arika Sun”) with a precision munition, fully disabling the ship’s propulsion without harming the crew," the US Central Command posted on X.
CENTCOM said the cargo vessel had attempted to transit regional waters after leaving an Iranian port.
Reuters was not immediately able to reach the bulk carrier's operator for comment.
CENTCOM warned mariners in the Gulf of Oman and the approaches to the Strait of Hormuz to heed blockade warnings, monitor notice-to-mariners broadcasts and contact US naval forces.
The number of vessels [USN:L1N45U0AH TEXT:"transiting"] the vital strait fell to the lowest in more than two months after attacks on tankers reached their highest level last week since the US and Israel launched the war on Iran in February, raising concerns over shipping disruptions and supporting crude prices.
Before the war, the Strait of Hormuz carried 20% of the world's oil consumption.

items.title: 成長の好循環「少しずつ見えてきた」、定着へ責任ある積極財政＝官房長官
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［東京　１１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［東京　１１日　ロイター］ - 木原稔官房長官は１１日のＮＨＫの報道番組に出演し、高市早苗政権の経済政策により成長の好循環が少しずつ見えてきたと指摘し、変化の兆しが定着するまで「しっかりと責任ある積極財政」を行う考えを示した。

木原氏は、設備投資や雇用の増加が賃金上昇につながり、消費の増加、企業の事業収益、税収増などにつながる成長の好循環が少しずつ見えてきたと分析した。責任ある積極財政により、国内投資を引き出し、潜在成長率を引き上げ、「ＧＤＰが拡大していく中で成長の好循環を実現していきたい」と語った。

物価高対策に関連して補正予算を編成する可能性を問われると、「エネルギー価格の変動にこれから注目していきたい」とした上で、ガソリン価格を１リットル当たり１７０円に抑えている現状を改めて説明。「これに加えて何をしていくかということは、しっかりと影響を注視していきたい」と話した。

items.title: サッカー＝田中先発のリーズ、昨季王者アーセナルに逆転負け
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ロンドン　１０日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
［ロンドン　１０日　ロイター］　 - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグは１０日、各地で試合を行い、田中碧が所属するリーズは昨季王者アーセナルに１─２の逆転負けを喫した。

リーズは後半１０分にジェームズ・ジャスティンのゴールで先制したが、その７分後にアーセナルのリッカルド・カラフィオーリに同点ゴールを献上。さらに同２５分、途中出場のブルーノ・ギマランイスにゴール隅へのシュートを決められた。田中は先発し、後半２６分までプレーした。

ＧＫ鈴木彩艶がフル出場したアストンビラはブレントフォードと２─２のドロー。前田大然が所属するイプスウィッチはフラムに２─１で逆転勝ち。前田は先発し、後半３６分までピッチに立った。三笘薫が所属するブライトンはサンダーランドに２─０で勝利。三笘はベンチ入りしなかった。

この他、チェルシーはボーンマスに５─１で圧勝。マンチェスター・ユナイテッドはトットナムと１─１で引き分けた。

６試合を消化したアーセナルが首位マンチェスター・シティー（マンＣ）と同じ勝ち点１５に伸ばし、２位に浮上した。ブライトンが同１３で３位。マンＣは１１日、敵地でリバプールと対戦する。

items.title: Bills WR DJ Moore questionable, DT Ed Oliver out vs. Rams
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Buffalo Bills receiver DJ Moore was a limited practice participant on Saturday due to his shoulder injury and was listed as questionable for Monday night's road game against the Los Angeles Rams.
items.body:
Buffalo Bills receiver DJ Moore was a limited practice participant on Saturday due to his shoulder injury and was listed as questionable for Monday night's road game against the Los Angeles Rams.
Star defensive tackle Ed Oliver (knee) and receiver Joshua Palmer (shoulder) were ruled out by the Bills. Palmer was added to the report on Friday and missed Saturday's session.
Moore injured his left shoulder for the second time this season in the second quarter of last Sunday's 29-26 loss to the New England Patriots. Oliver was injured in the third quarter against New England.
Moore, 29, has 12 receptions for 178 yards and one touchdown in four games this season. He was obtained in the offseason from the Chicago Bears.
Oliver, 28, has nine tackles, one fumble recovery and half a sack in three games this season.
Cornerback Dee Alford (ankle) and defensive lineman Landon Jackson (knee) are also questionable for Buffalo.
For the Rams, safety Quentin Lake (hip) is questionable. Star defensive lineman Aaron Donald (back) didn't practice Saturday but is good to go for the contest.
Also, Los Angeles coach Sean McVay said defensive end Myles Garrett is progressing from knee surgery but the team is unlikely to open his 21-day practice window next week.
Garrett struggled in the season-opening loss against the San Francisco 49ers and cited knee irritation as a factor. The Rams placed him on injured reserve on Sept. 17.
"He's making good progress," McVay told reporters. "As far as what that timeline looks like, it's kind of week-to-week in terms of how he feels. But I would say it's more likely that we do not start his clock next week."
Garrett, the reigning NFL Defensive Player of the Year, was acquired from the Cleveland Browns in the offseason.
--Field Level Media
