items.title: Kirill Kaprizov nets hat trick as Wild hand Panthers rare loss
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Kirill Kaprizov tallied his seventh career hat trick and added an assist, and the Minnesota Wild pulled away for a 4-1 win over the Florida Panthers on Saturday evening in Sunrise, Fla.
items.body:
Kirill Kaprizov tallied his seventh career hat trick and added an assist, and the Minnesota Wild pulled away for a 4-1 win over the Florida Panthers on Saturday evening in Sunrise, Fla.
Matt Boldy finished with a goal and an assist for Minnesota, which snapped a two-game winless skid. Quinn Hughes was one of four other Wild players to tally an assist.
Matthew Tkachuk scored the lone goal for Florida. The outcome marked the Panthers' first loss in regulation in five games this season.
Wild goaltender Jesper Wallstedt stopped 29 of 30 shots to earn the victory.
Panthers goaltender Jacob Markstrom allowed three goals on 28 shots.
Minnesota jumped out to a 1-0 lead in the first minute of the game. Boldy carried the puck into the offensive zone and fired a wrist shot above Markstrom's left shoulder 53 seconds in.
The Wild increased their lead to 2-0 with a power-play goal at 6:18 of the first period. Maxim Shabanov fed a cross-ice pass to Kaprizov, who buried a one-timer from the right circle.
Florida cut the deficit to 2-1 at 2:18 of the second period. Tkachuk kept the puck on a two-on-one rush but his shot was kicked out by Wallstedt. Tkachuk followed the rebound and scored on his second chance from near the front of the crease.
Kaprizov struck again to boost the Wild's lead to 3-1 at 5:00 of the second. He scored on a wrist shot from the right circle.
The Wild's top scorer finished his hat trick with an empty-net goal at 18:56 of the third. Kaprizov got the puck in Minnesota's defensive zone and flipped a long shot into the open net for his sixth goal in five games this season.
Wild forward Rieger Lorenz made his NHL debut. The 22-year-old Calgary native was Minnesota's second-round pick (No. 56 overall) in the 2022 NHL Draft.
--Field Level Media

items.title: South Korea completes Arctic-Europe commercial voyage, eyes regular service despite risks
items.author: Joyce Lee
items.creator: Joyce Lee
items.summary: A South Korean container ship completed the country's first commercial round trip to Europe via the Arctic on Sunday, as authorities bank on the route helping turn the port of Busan into a global maritime hub.
items.body:
A South Korean container ship completed the country's first commercial round trip to Europe via the Arctic on Sunday, as authorities bank on the route helping turn the port of Busan into a global maritime hub.
The PanStar Acro docked in the southeastern port 50 days after setting sail on August 22. Authorities say the Arctic route could cut typical voyage times by around a third.
President Lee Jae Myung has made Arctic shipping a priority, and officials hope to launch regular services by 2030.
But the project [USN:L1N44J01G TEXT:"risks friction"] with Western allies hoping to keep Russia isolated during its war in Ukraine. The route runs along Russia's Arctic coast, and Seoul consulted with Moscow about the journey, including whether the ship needed help to tackle any problems, such as getting stuck in ice.
On its outbound voyage, the vessel passed through Arctic waters and reached its first European port, Felixstowe in Britain, before calling at Rotterdam and Gdansk and returning home via the Arctic.
The trial voyage also highlighted the challenges ahead. Before the departure, PanStar told Reuters it was seeking about 1,300 twenty-foot equivalent units of cargo, but the ship left with 737 TEU of cargo plus empty containers.
Industry experts have said the route's value will depend on reliable schedules, the costs of slowing to avoid ice, special insurance premiums and extra fuel use.

items.title: サッカー＝バイエルン最速失点許すも引き分け、伊藤は出番な
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［アウクスブルク（ドイツ）　１０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［アウクスブルク（ドイツ）　１０日　ロイター］ - サッカーのドイツ１部ブンデスリーガは１０日、各地で試合を行い、伊藤洋輝が所属するバイエルン・ミュンヘンはアウクスブルクに２回リードされながらも追い付き、２─２で引き分けた。

バイエルンは開始８秒、ＧＫマヌエル・ノイアーが味方に出そうとしたパスをロビン・フェルハウアーに奪われ、同リーグ史上最速での失点を喫した。

後半１０分にハリー・ケーンのラストパスをイスマエル・サイバリが決めて追い付くも、その９分後、ノイアーがロドリゴ・リベイロの前にボールを弾き、これを押し込まれて１─２に。それでも最後はケーンのお膳立てからナサニエル・ブラウンがネットを揺らし、ドローに持ち込んだ。伊藤はベンチ入りしたが出番はなかった。

佐野海舟が先発出場したマインツはレーバークーゼンに３─４で敗れた。立ち上がりの２失点を前半のうちに返したが、後半に再び２失点。同アディショナルタイム２分に１点を返すにとどまった。佐野は同３６分までプレー。川崎颯太はベンチ入りしたが出場しなかった。

小杉啓太と堂安律が先発したアイントラハト・フランクフルトはライプチヒに０─６の大敗。クリストファー・エンクンクのハットトリックを許すなど前半のうちに０─４と大きくリードされ、後半も反撃できないまま２点を追加された。小杉は前半のみの出場。堂安は後半２８分までプレーした。

町田浩樹所属のホッフェンハイムはハンブルガーＳＶに２─３で黒星。先発した町田は後半２９分までピッチに立った。

５試合を終えてバイエルンは勝ち点１１で首位ドルトムントと２差の暫定２位。マインツは同７で暫定８位、フランクフルトは同５で暫定１３位、ホッフェンハイムは同３で暫定１７位としている。

items.title: ゴルフ＝砂川が日本勢最高17位に浮上、ベイカレント・クラシック
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１０日　ロイター］ - 米男子ゴルフの秋季シリーズ、ベイカレント・クラシック・レクサスは１０日、神奈川県横浜ＣＣ（パー７１）で第３ラウンドを行い、砂川公佑が日本勢最高の１７位に順位を上げた。

３０位でスタートした砂川は６バーディー、２ボギーの４アンダー６７でラウンド。通算７アンダーの２０６に伸ばした。

６８をマークした金谷拓実と６９で回った久常涼が通算６アンダーの２２位に浮上した。松山英樹、米沢蓮と細野勇策は通算５アンダーの２９位。石坂友宏は通算３アンダーの４４位に後退。香妻陣一朗は４７位、藤本佳則と中島啓太は５１位、岩崎亜久竜は５７位、岩田寛とアマチュアの長崎煌心は６５位となった。

マイケル・ブレナン、ザック・ボーシュー、ジェーコブ・ブリッジマン（以上米国）が通算１３アンダーの首位で並んだ。２０１３年のマスターズ・トーナメント王者で、２０年以来となるＰＧＡツアーでの優勝を目指すアダム・スコット（オーストラリア）ら５選手が１打差の４位につけている。

ディフェンディングチャンピオンのザンダー・シャウフェレ（米国）は通算９アンダーで、首位とは４打差の１２位。

items.title: ペンシルベニア州で45歳の男が銃撃、妊婦含む8人死亡
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[１０日 ロイター] - 米ペンシルベニア州エリーで９日に銃撃事件が発生し、妊婦１人と子ども２人を含む８人が死亡した。その後に４５歳の男が自身を撃ったとみられ、死亡した。地元当局が１０日、記者会見で詳細を明らかにした。

当局は容疑者の身元をまだ公表していない。エリー警察のリック・ローラ署長によると、警官が現場に到着する前に自ら銃で撃って死亡したとみられる。

犯行の動機は分かっていない。死亡した９人のうち８人は家族で、１人は家族の友人だったという。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１０日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）ガーディアンズのギャビン・ウィリアムズ投手（２７）が、１０日に行われるア・リーグ地区シリーズ（５回戦制）、ホワイトソックスとの第５戦に先発登板する。同投手は８日の第４戦にリリーフ登板していた。

ウィリアムズはレギュラーシーズンでは３２試合に先発し、チームトップの１４勝をマーク。救援登板はなかった。

シリーズ第４戦では４点リードの九回途中から８番手として登板し、１８球を投げて１安打無失点。ガーディアンズが９─５で勝利し、最終第５戦に持ち込んだ。ガーディアンズのスティーブン・ボート監督は９日、ウィリアムズは前日のリリーフ登板から順調に回復していると述べていた。

ウィリアムズは５日に行われた第２戦に先発。５回０／３で４安打２失点、１１奪三振の内容で勝敗は付かなかった。ガーディアンズは３─４で負けた。

村上宗隆内野手が所属するホワイトソックスは、第５戦でショーン・バーク投手（２６）が先発する。レギュラーシーズンでの１１勝はチーム最多だった。村上は第５戦に「４番・一塁」で出場する予定。

items.title: Real's Vinicius apologises after red card for hair pull against Villarreal
items.author: Ruairidh Barlow
items.creator: Ruairidh Barlow
items.summary: Real Madrid's Vinicius Jr has apologised to his teammates and the club's fans after being sent off in the 1-0 win over Villarreal in LaLiga at the Santiago Bernabeu on Saturday.
items.body:
Real Madrid's Vinicius Jr has apologised to his teammates and the club's fans after being sent off in the [USN:L6N45W060 TEXT:"1-0 win over Villarreal"] in LaLiga at the Santiago Bernabeu on Saturday.
Vinicius now faces a nervous wait for the ruling of the disciplinary committee, which could see him miss Real's fixture with rivals Barcelona on October 25 at Camp Nou.
The Brazilian thought he had scored Real's second goal but his effort was disallowed after a VAR review found he should be dismissed for pulling Nathan Saliba's hair in the build-up.
After the match, Vinicius, who came on in the 52nd minute and was red carded 20 minutes later, posted on social media, saying, "sorry to the team and the fans."
Spanish Football Federation regulations state that pulling an opponent's hair is regarded as violent conduct.
The sanction for violent conduct without causing injury to an opponent (Article 130) is a ban of one to three matches.
Real's next three LaLiga games are against Sevilla, Barca and Racing Santander, but missing El Clasico would be a bitter blow for the 26-year-old Brazil international.

items.author: ロイター

items.summary: [ワシントン １０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン １０日 ロイター] - ルビオ米国務長官は１０日、沖縄県で日本人女性が殺害された事件を巡り、強盗殺人容疑で米海兵隊員を捜査している日本側に全面的に協力する考えを示した。茂木敏充外相との電話会談後、米国務省が発表した。

国務省によると、ルビオ氏は日本人女性の死亡に哀悼の意を表明。日本政府や地元当局による捜査に「全面的に協力する米国の決意」を伝えた。

日本外務省によると、両外相は「事件の発生防止のために実効性のある措置を取るべく、日米間で協議していくこと」を確認した。

沖縄県警は４日、米軍普天間基地所属のデビン・ジェイコブ・バラード海兵隊上等兵を強盗殺人容疑で逮捕した。バラード容疑者は容疑を否認している。

items.title: Carney aprovecha la guerra comercial con Trump para acelerar la transformación económica de Canadá
items.author: Nojoud Al Mallees
items.summary: La guerra comercial del presidente Donald Trump contra Canadá está permitiendo al primer ministro Mark Carney acelerar una agenda industrial que habría sido motivo de profundas divisiones hace tan sol ...
items.body: Bloomberg — La guerra comercial del presidente Donald Trump contra Canadá está permitiendo al primer ministro Mark Carney pisar a fondo el acelerador en una agenda industrial que habría sido muy controvertida hace tan solo unos años. Ver más: Trump dice que Ucrania necesita un nuevo presidente capaz de negociar con Putin Sin un final a la vista para los aranceles estadounidenses, el exbanquero central se ha centrado en eliminar los obstáculos a la inversión, lo que incluye derogar normas introducidas por su predecesor y otorgar al Gobierno nuevas y amplias competencias para acelerar los proyectos de infraestructuras y energía. El principal objetivo de Carney ha sido un nuevo oleoducto hacia la costa oeste, que la semana pasada fue designado proyecto de interés nacional, lo que en la práctica lo considera preaprobado, sujeto a una serie de condiciones. Su Gobierno también está llevando a cabo una reforma regulatoria de gran alcance, que Carney describió como la reforma más ambiciosa en materia de capacidad de construcción de Canadá en toda una generación. Para seguir adelante, está recurriendo a una gran reserva de capital político. Sus índices de aprobación han alcanzado nuevos máximos este otoño, y las encuestas muestran un amplio apoyo a sus planes —al menos por ahora—. Los líderes empresariales, que en un principio se mostraron escépticos ante la promesa de Carney de convertir a Canadá en una superpotencia energética y de flexibilizar las regulaciones de Justin Trudeau que frenaban el desarrollo de los recursos, se están sumando cada vez más a la iniciativa y elogian las políticas favorables a la inversión del primer ministro. En menos de dos semanas, Carney celebró la primera cumbre de inversión del país, anunció una nueva e importante desgravación fiscal para el gasto de capital y presentó una ley para reformar el proceso de aprobación de proyectos y facilitar el fin de las huelgas laborales. “Lo llamé ‘los 12 días de Navidad para el sector del petróleo y el gas’”, afirmó Heather Exner-Pirot, directora de energía, recursos naturales y medio ambiente del Instituto Macdonald-Laurier. Pero no todo el mundo comparte ese espíritu festivo. Los críticos sostienen que la nueva legislación de Carney corre el riesgo de deteriorar las relaciones con las comunidades indígenas, degradar el medio ambiente y politizar aún más el proceso de aprobación de proyectos, al permitir que el gobierno de turno elija a su antojo los proyectos a los que quiere dar luz verde. “Se trata de un cambio tectónico en la forma en que el Gobierno federal aborda la revisión y aprobación de grandes proyectos. Y, en general, supone un importante paso atrás en numerosos frentes desde el punto de vista de la protección medioambiental”, afirmó David Wright, profesor asociado de Derecho en la Universidad de Calgary. El proyecto de ley C-39, conocido como “Ley para fortalecer Canadá”, reduciría a un año el plazo para que el Gobierno federal tome decisiones sobre todos los proyectos. Además, obligaría a los ministerios a realizar evaluaciones simultáneas, en lugar de secuenciales, con una mayor coordinación para que cada proyecto se someta a una única revisión. La legislación se basa en el proyecto de ley C-5, una ley que el Gobierno aprobó el año pasado para agilizar los grandes proyectos considerados de interés nacional. Pero la Ley para fortalecer Canadá va mucho más allá de la mera agilización del proceso de solicitud. Permitiría al Gobierno preaprobar proyectos, sujetos a determinadas condiciones, en zonas que designe como regiones de interés nacional. El Gobierno afirma que una zona solo obtendría esa designación tras una evaluación destinada a identificar los tipos de actividades que se permitirían en ella y las medidas de mitigación que se exigirían. La legislación también otorgaría a los ministros mayor discrecionalidad sobre proyectos concretos, permitiéndoles, en algunos casos, ordenar que se inicien las obras antes de que se apruebe un proyecto y modificar o eximir del cumplimiento de las condiciones medioambientales asociadas al mismo. La ampliación de la infraestructura energética y comercial de Canadá es parte integral del plan de Carney para que el país se diversifique más allá de EE.UU., que fue el destino del 85% de las exportaciones energéticas canadienses el año pasado. Carney ha defendido sus reformas normativas, argumentando que fue elegido para que Canadá volviera a la senda de la construcción. “Década tras década, año tras año, construimos cada vez menos. Añadimos más y más restricciones”, afirmó Carney el mes pasado. “Identificamos ese problema en un momento de gran riesgo para nuestro país, cuando nuestra soberanía se veía amenazada y, en cierta medida, sigue estándolo”. Carney tomó las riendas del Partido Liberal de Canadá de manos de Trudeau el año pasado y ha cambiado radicalmente su política energética. Exner-Pirot atribuye este cambio en gran parte a las tensiones comerciales con EE.UU., que “nos sacaron de nuestra complacencia” y pusieron de relieve que los recursos naturales son “la opción más accesible para diversificar las relaciones comerciales”. El otro factor, según ella, es el repunte de los precios de las materias primas. Tanto las tensiones geopolíticas como el auge de los centros de datos están ejerciendo una presión al alza sobre la demanda energética, tendencias que ya han resultado ser una bendición para las empresas energéticas canadienses. “Solo en una fase bajista de las materias primas podría Justin Trudeau ser primer ministro de Canadá. Y en una fase alcista, el coste de mostrarse contrario al petróleo y al gas en Ottawa es demasiado elevado”, afirmó. El proyecto de ley también otorga al Gobierno más peso en la aprobación de oleoductos antes de que concluyan las evaluaciones federales. En el caso de los oleoductos que supongan más de 300 kilómetros (186 millas) de nuevo trazado, el Regulador de Energía de Canadá (CER) deberá presentar un informe al Consejo de Ministros sobre el proyecto en un plazo de seis meses desde la recepción de la solicitud. Si el Consejo de Ministros da luz verde, el CER continuará entonces con su evaluación para decidir qué condiciones deben imponerse. “Simplemente no creo que se pueda llevar a cabo una revisión efectiva de una propuesta en un plazo de seis meses”, afirmó George Vegh , expresidente del consejo de administración de la Autoridad Reguladora de la Energía de Canadá, en una entrevista. Vegh señaló que uno de los retos de un plazo de revisión más corto es que puede llevar tiempo consultar a las comunidades indígenas, que a menudo quieren contratar a sus propios expertos para evaluar las propuestas. El proyecto de ley C-39 permitiría al Gobierno ampliar el plazo de revisión de un proyecto si fuera necesario para llevar a cabo las consultas con las comunidades indígenas. Vegh señaló que algunos elementos de la nueva legislación, como una mayor coordinación de los permisos federales, mejorarán el proceso. Sin embargo, añadió que el proyecto de ley consolida un importante escollo de las revisiones de proyectos al mantener el poder de decisión definitivo en manos del Consejo de Ministros. “Si se desea un proceso predecible, es preciso conocer cuáles son las normas. Estas deben ser vinculantes y no estar diseñadas en beneficio de proyectos concretos”, afirmó Vegh. Una encuesta realizada por Abacus Data y Vantage reveló que dos tercios de los canadienses desean que los grandes proyectos se construyan más rápidamente, pero hay menos apoyo a la idea de acortar las evaluaciones medioambientales o aprobar proyectos sin el respaldo de las comunidades indígenas. A los defensores del medio ambiente les preocupa esta situación. Por ejemplo, el proyecto de ley permitiría a los promotores de proyectos que pudieran perjudicar a los peces realizar aportaciones a un fondo en lugar de compensar ellos mismos el impacto. Además, se exigiría a los responsables de la toma de decisiones que tuvieran en cuenta la “viabilidad técnica, económica y práctica” de cualquier condición que impusieran. “El proyecto de ley C-39 no es una reforma meditada”, afirmó Charlie Hatt, director de clima de Ecojustice, una organización benéfica dedicada al derecho medioambiental. “Este proyecto de ley allana el camino para proyectos masivos de petróleo y gas que no harán más que agravar los fenómenos meteorológicos extremos que ya están perjudicando nuestra salud y amenazando a nuestras comunidades”. --Con la colaboración de Mario Baker Ramírez. items.title: Justice Department probes TV networks over Trump pool boycott
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The US Justice Department said on Saturday it is investigating whether television networks violated federal antitrust laws over their decision to boycott covering the White House following its decision to pull the credentials of reporters from three news organizations, including CNN.
items.body:
The US Justice Department said on Saturday it is investigating whether television networks violated federal antitrust laws over their decision to boycott covering the White House following its decision to pull the credentials of reporters from three news organizations, including CNN.
The networks under investigation are ABC, CBS, CNN, NBC and Fox News, the Justice Department said.
"Group boycotts among commercial competitors can violate the Sherman Act," a Justice Department spokesperson said.
"The Antitrust Division is simply investigating to determine whether these news organizations have violated the antitrust laws."
The investigation is the latest in a series of clashes between the Trump administration and major news organizations. President Donald Trump has repeatedly called the mainstream media "fake news" and frequently clashes with reporters during encounters with the press.
The action also puts legal and potentially financial pressure on the media to continue coverage of the president even when they disagree with how the White House handles them.
The networks did not immediately respond to requests from Reuters for comment. The New York Times was first to report about the probe.
The investigation comes after weeks of tension between the White House and the press.
CREDENTIALS REVOKED IN SEPTEMBER On September 19, the White House blocked reporters from CNN, Politico, and MS NOW from entering the building, revoking their credentials. The White House said covering the president was a "privilege – not a right.” The outlets sued the administration, alleging the exclusions violated the First Amendment and that the White House was retaliating over their coverage.
CNN is one of the five news organizations — along with ABC, CBS, Fox News and NBC — that make up the primary White House television pool. They share the costs of covering the president, take turns organizing coverage and share the footage with outlets around the country.
All of the five television networks that cover the White House, including Fox News, suspended coverage in solidarity and refused to provide replacement coverage.
The White House reinstated the credentials on September 24 after US District Judge Timothy Kelly ruled that the ban was likely unconstitutional and ordered the administration to "immediately return, reinstate, and restore" their access. However, disputes over access to specific presidential events and pool assignments continued afterward.

items.title: Macklin Celebrini scores in return, but Oilers stifle Sharks
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Tristan Jarry made 19 saves as the Edmonton Oilers skated to a 3-1 win against the host San Jose Sharks on Saturday afternoon.
items.body:
Tristan Jarry made 19 saves as the Edmonton Oilers skated to a 3-1 win against the host San Jose Sharks on Saturday afternoon.
Mattias Ekholm, Vasily Podkolzin and Alex Formenton scored while Connor McDavid increased his early-season points total to 13 with an assist for the Oilers, who have won four straight games since dropping their season opener to the Vancouver Canucks.
Macklin Celebrini's first goal of the season was the lone score for the Sharks, who have dropped two of their last three. Celebrini, who missed two games with a lower-body injury, led San Jose with 21:59 of ice time and placed two shots on goal. Yaroslav Askarov made 17 saves.
Ekholm put Edmonton up 1-0 at 12:37 of the first period. Isaac Howard set Ekholm up for a slap shot through traffic from between the faceoff circles.
San Jose and Edmonton each had five shots on goal in the first frame, while the Sharks out-hit the Oilers 17-7.
The Oilers didn't register a shot on goal in the second period until 6:09 remained. Celebrini almost tied the game 1-1 with five seconds left in the frame, but his shot rang off the post.
Podkolzin increased Edmonton's lead to 2-0 at 3:13 of the third period. After an Oilers power play expired, McDavid set Podkolzin up with a backward pass and the winger scored on a slap shot.
Formenton added to Edmonton's tally with a backhanded shot past Askarov to make the score 3-0 at 5:40.
Celebrini put the Sharks on the board 3-1 at 11:19. Michael Misa set up the goal with a backhanded pass from against the boards and Celebrini scored on a wrist shot.
--Field Level Media

items.title: US will learn from bruising friendly defeat by Spain, says Hayes
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: US women's coach Emma Hayes shook off a dismal 2-0 defeat on Saturday in the first of two friendlies against Spain, with the Americans building towards next month's World Cup qualifiers.
items.body:
US women's coach Emma Hayes shook off a dismal 2-0 defeat on Saturday in the first of two friendlies against Spain, with the Americans building towards next month's World Cup qualifiers.
The match between top-ranked Spain and the Olympic champions was billed as a marquee showdown but the visitors took control as Patri Guijarro and Eva Navarro scored inside 15 minutes.
Spain's Adriana Nanclares saved a second-half penalty from Lily Yohannes to keep a clean sheet for the world champions.
"When you play the best team in the world you have to execute everything really well in the first instance," said Hayes. "Did I think we did enough to score a goal? Of course we did. Did we do enough to score more than one? Absolutely.
"We just didn't make necessarily the right decision and execute with the quality I know we should have."
The US had 10 shots on target to three from Spain, who had Athenea Del Castillo sent off in added time for pulling Michelle Cooper's hair three minutes after coming off the bench.
Hayes said that efficiency would be a key target for the US when the two sides play again on Tuesday.
"We create the most chances in world football. But finishing, we do not do that in world football," Hayes told reporters. "So I wasn't concerned about us creating today, and I'm not concerned about us finishing. You just have to lock in, get the details right, and keep working on it."
The US aim to qualify for the 2027 World Cup in Brazil via the Concacaf W Championship, three years after their worst performance at the global tournament where they exited in the last 16 and Spain staked their territory as the world's finest.
Briton Hayes' arrival [USN:L8N3C60IU TEXT:"months later"] from Chelsea sparked a renaissance for the US, who collected gold in Paris and welcomed back veteran [USN:L6N45L15G TEXT:"Mallory Swanson"] to camp this month.
"We've got some really, really good players and we're a really good team regardless of the result today," said Hayes. "I think we're much closer to them than we were three years ago."

items.title: UCLA QB Nico Iamaleava (leg) leaves game vs. Oregon
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: UCLA quarterback Nico Iamaleava suffered an apparent leg injury just before halftime of the No. 21 Bruins' Big Ten Conference game at No. 13 Oregon on Saturday.
items.body:
UCLA quarterback Nico Iamaleava suffered an apparent leg injury just before halftime of the No. 21 Bruins' Big Ten Conference game at No. 13 Oregon on Saturday.
Iamaleava did not come out with the UCLA offense on its first drive after intermission. Backup Ty Dieffenbach took over. Iamaleava returned to the sideline in street clothes during the third quarter, signaling the end of his day.
Iamaleava committed three turnovers in the first half, including an interception thrown into the end zone on his final play. It was the second pick Iamaleava threw in less than two minutes. He appeared to have suffered the injury on the first one.
He got up gingerly with the help of UCLA training staff after taking a hit from Oregon defensive lineman Bear Alexander. Jerry Mixon intercepted Iamaleava's under-duress throw.
Iamaleava finished 10-for-17 passing for 162 yards, no touchdowns and the two interceptions. He also lost a fumble inside the Bruins' 10, which led to an Oregon touchdown, in the first quarter.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Patriots place WR Mack Hollins (calf) on injured reserve
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The New England Patriots placed leading receiver Mack Hollins on injured reserve Saturday due to a calf injury.
items.body:
The New England Patriots placed leading receiver Mack Hollins on injured reserve Saturday due to a calf injury.
Hollins is required to miss at least four games. He leads New England in receptions (15) and receiving yardage (209).
Hollins, 33, was injured during the third quarter of last week's 29-26 victory over the Buffalo Bills.
The injury to Hollins comes with A.J. Brown (ankle) already on the injured list. New England's receivers group against the visiting Las Vegas Raiders on Sunday will consist of Romeo Doubs, DeMario Douglas, Efton Chism III and Kyle Williams.
The Patriots also placed fullback Reggie Gilliam (ankle/knee) on IR.
New England also activated special teams standout Brenden Schooler (back) from the non-football injured list, signed cornerback Kindle Vildor to the 53-man roster and elevated linebacker K.J. Britt and safety Elliott Davison from the practice squad for Sunday's game.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Top 25 roundup: Oklahoma stuns No. 1 Texas on walk-off field goal
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Tate Sandell hit a 47-yard field goal with no time left on the clock to give Oklahoma a 27-24 upset of No. 1 Texas on Saturday in Dallas.
items.body:
Tate Sandell hit a 47-yard field goal with no time left on the clock to give Oklahoma a 27-24 upset of No. 1 Texas on Saturday in Dallas.
Courtland Guillory intercepted Arch Manning at the Oklahoma 39 with 19 seconds left in regulation to give the Sooners (3-2, 1-1 Southeastern Conference) a shot. Completions of 13 and 20 yards from John Mateer to Isaiah Sategna gave Sandell the chance to win it.
The win was Oklahoma's first over the Longhorns (4-1, 1-1 SEC) since 2023 and its first over a top-ranked opponent since beating Missouri in the 2007 Big 12 Championship Game. Oklahoma had never before beaten a No. 1 opponent when unranked.
Manning finished 19 of 31 for 260 yards and three touchdowns, but he also threw two interceptions that helped sink the Longhorns, who outgained the Sooners 382-238.
No. 2 Georgia 20, No. 6 Alabama 17
Gunner Stockton threw for 249 yards and a touchdown while rushing for another score to help the Bulldogs earn a victory over the Crimson Tide in Tuscaloosa, Ala.
Dwight Phillips Jr. rushed for a career-high 120 yards for Georgia (6-0, 4-0 SEC), which posted its first regular-season win over Alabama since 2007 -- also the last victory for the Bulldogs in Tuscaloosa. Peyton Woodring's 23-yard field goal with 5:25 left proved to be the game-winning play.
Keelon Russell completed 16 of 30 passes for 185 yards and a touchdown for Alabama (5-1, 3-1), which was outgained 455-346 and trailed 10-0 before jumping ahead 14-10 at halftime on EJ Crowell's 1-yard TD run on the final play of the first half.
No. 3 Notre Dame 58, Stanford 7
Jonaz Walton rushed for 181 yards and two touchdowns, including a 97-yard scoring run, and the host Fighting Irish pummeled the Cardinal in South Bend, Ind.
CJ Carr completed 14 of 20 passes for 181 yards and three touchdowns for Notre Dame (6-0), which never trailed. Nolan James Jr. rushed for 73 yards and two scores.
Davis Warren completed 12 of 22 passes for 144 yards with one touchdown and one interception for Stanford (2-4), which was outgained 598-202, including 361-58 on the ground.
No. 5 Ohio State 45, Maryland 16
Julian Sayin threw four first-half touchdown passes, two to Jeremiah Smith, and the Buckeyes rolled past the Terrapins in Columbus, Ohio.
Sayin passed for 203 yards in the first 30 minutes as the Buckeyes (5-1, 3-0 Big Ten) took a 31-10 halftime lead. Smith's first TD, the 37th of his career, tied Michigan's Anthony Carter for second all-time in the Big Ten. The second one moved Smith one behind record-holder Braylon Edwards of Michigan. Bo Jackson ran for 107 yards and two second-half touchdowns to ice the game.
Maryland used a 52-yard pick-six by Daniel Wingate to pull Maryland (2-4, 0-3) within 31-16 with 5:12 left in the third quarter. Maryland QB Malik Washington completed 12 of 25 passes for 64 yards.
No. 7 Indiana 20, Nebraska 17
Josh Hoover hit Nick Marsh for two long touchdown passes and rallied the Hoosiers to a Big Ten victory over the Cornhuskers in Lincoln, Neb.
Hoover completed 12 of 22 passes for 263 yards and two scores as the Hoosiers (6-0, 3-0) shrugged off their first deficit of the season to extend their winning streak to 22 games heading into next week's home showdown against Ohio State.
Nebraska limited the nation's No. 9 rushing offense to 65 yards -- far below the Hoosiers' 252.6-yard average. Anthony Colandrea, whose 39-yard touchdown keeper gave Nebraska a 17-6 lead with 12:01 to go, finished with 263 passing yards and 47 rushing yards as the Huskers (5-1, 2-1) came up short against a Top 25 foe for the 31st consecutive time.
No. 9 Ole Miss 52, Vanderbilt 17
Trinidad Chambliss threw three touchdown passes and the Rebels scored four touchdowns in a nine-minute span of the second quarter in a rout of the host Commodores in Nashville, Tenn.
Chambliss completed 20 of 30 passes for 213 yards with an interception. He also accounted for a rushing touchdown. Deuce Alexander caught a 39-yard touchdown pass and Shekai Mills-Knight produced a touchdown run of 35 yards for Ole Miss (4-1, 2-1).
Jared Curtis returned from a one-week absence due to a knee injury to pass for 222 yards and a touchdown for Vanderbilt (3-3, 0-3), but he also committed three turnovers, two of which led to touchdowns during the second-quarter blitz.
Kentucky 35, No. 10 LSU 34 (OT)
Kenny Minchey drove the Wildcats to a tying field goal at the end of regulation and ran in the decisive two-point conversion in overtime as they defeated the Tigers in SEC play in Lexington, Ky.
CJ Baxter rushed for 123 yards and two touchdowns, Minchey passed for 246 yards and the Wildcats (5-1, 3-1) won by the same score on a two-point overtime conversion as they did the previous Saturday at South Carolina.
Sam Leavitt passed for 275 yards, two touchdowns and one interception, Jackson Harris caught one of those scoring passes and tossed one of his own for LSU (4-2, 1-2).
No. 12 Utah 41, Kansas 24
Wayshawn Parker ran for 171 yards and two touchdowns to lead the Utes to a victory over the Jayhawks in Salt Lake City.
It marked Parker's second straight game with more than 170 rushing yards after he posted a career-high 174 yards on the ground in Utah's win at Iowa State on Sept. 26. Devon Dampier completed 23 of 30 passes for 238 yards and three touchdowns to help the Utes (5-0, 2-0 Big 12) keep their record unblemished. Dampier added 68 yards and a score on the ground. Ricky Johnson led the Utah receivers with a season-high 104 yards and a touchdown on five catches.
Isaiah Marshall was 19 of 37 for 333 passing yards and two touchdowns to lead Kansas. Cam Pickett, in his third game, tallied a season-high 134 yards on eight catches for the Jayhawks (2-3, 0-2), who outscored the Utes 17-7 in the second quarter to cut the halftime deficit to 21-17 and trailed 27-24 late in the third quarter.
No. 21 UCLA 17, No. 13 Oregon 15
Wayne Knight rushed for a touchdown and caught another while the Bruins' defense stuffed a late two-point conversion attempt to earn a Big Ten win over the Ducks in Eugene, Ore.
UCLA (5-0, 3-0 Big Ten) had not won in Autzen Stadium since 2004, but Knight's 9-yard score off a Ty Dieffenbach pass in the third quarter gave the Bruins a 17-6 lead that proved to be enough of a cushion to snap their eight-game losing streak on Oregon's field. Knight finished with 22 carries for 103 yards and caught three passes for 12 yards.
Oregon (3-2, 1-1) battled back in the fourth quarter after Brock Thomas replaced quarterback Dylan Raiola, who started in place of injured Dante Moore. Thomas hit 11 of 15 passes for 156 yards, which included a 44-yard touchdown strike to Evan Stewart that pulled the Ducks within two with 2:16 to go. After a facemask penalty gave Oregon another chance from the 1-yard line, UCLA's Tyson Ford stuffed Jordon Davison's rush on the subsequent attempt.
No. 14 Missouri 27, Texas A&M 6
Jamal Roberts rushed for 222 yards and two touchdowns, and the Tigers kept the Aggies out of the end zone in the SEC victory at Columbia, Mo. Roberts had 211 rushing yards a week ago against then-No. 8 Florida.
On Saturday, Missouri (5-1, 2-1) intercepted Marcel Reed twice, getting one pick apiece from Trajen Greco and Elijah Dotson. The Tigers allowed 216 total yards, including only 29 on the ground.
Texas A&M (3-3, 1-3), which has lost three of its past four games, trailed 10-3 at halftime and played effectively on defense until the second half, when Roberts and the Mizzou running game appeared to grind down the Aggies. Reed finished 19-of-39 passing for 187 yards.
No. 15 Tennessee 24, Arkansas 17
DeSean Bishop's 8-yard touchdown run with 1:57 remaining led the Volunteers past the Razorbacks in Fayetteville, Ark., for Tennessee's first road win against Arkansas since 2001.
Bishop had 19 carries for 138 yards and George MacIntyre was 18-for-29 passing for 247 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions in his first start for the Volunteers (5-1, 2-1 SEC) as he replaced injured true freshman Faizon Brandon.
KJ Jackson completed 15 of 27 passes for 155 yards with one touchdown for Arkansas (5-1, 2-1). Cam Settles led a balanced Razorback running game with 50 of the team's 133 rushing yards.
South Carolina 38, No. 16 Florida 19
Quarterback LaNorris Sellers fired four touchdown passes and rushed for a score as the Gamecocks broke a three-game losing streak with an upset of the Gators in Gainesville, Fla.
After blowing a 17-point lead in a home overtime loss last week against Kentucky, the Gamecocks (3-3, 1-3 SEC) snapped an eight-game conference losing streak as Sellers went 23 of 35 for 279 yards, with no interceptions. Nyck Harbor had 83 receiving yards and a touchdown on four catches.
The Gators (4-2, 2-2) lost their second straight game as Aaron Philo was 21 of 28 for 227 yards and a touchdown, with one interception. Bailey Stockton had 127 yards and a score on eight receptions. Florida's Jadan Baugh (15 carries, 59 yards) scored his NCAA-best 12th rushing touchdown of the season in the fourth quarter.
No. 18 Oklahoma State 42, UCF 28,
Drew Mestemaker threw for 304 yards and two touchdowns and rushed for a third as the Cowboys pulled away in the fourth quarter for the Big 12 triumph in Stillwater, Okla.
With Oklahoma State (4-1, 2-0) clinging to a 27-21 edge early in the fourth quarter, Evan Jackson returned a deflected backward pass 28 yards for a touchdown to give the Cowboys a 35-21 lead with 10:32 to go. After Oklahoma State stuffed a fourth-and-1 play, Mestemaker hit Wyatt Young for a 5-yard score to break it open.
Keyone Jenkins completed 30 of 42 passes for 265 yards and four touchdowns for UCF (3-3, 1-2). Josh Derry caught 11 passes for 84 yards and one score while Caden Piening added seven receptions for 60 yards and a score.
No. 19 USC 31, Penn State 23
Jayden Maiava passed for 301 yards and three touchdowns as the Trojans handed the Nittany Lions a third straight conference loss with a win in University Park, Pa.
Maiava threw a TD pass to Trent Mosley (nine catches, 111 yards), who had missed the previous three games, and also connected on scoring passes to Tanook Hines and Kayden Dixon-Wyatt. King Miller took care of matters on the ground for the Trojans (6-1, 3-1 Big Ten), rushing for 102 yards and a touchdown on 19 carries.
Rocco Becht threw for 289 yards and a score for Penn State (3-3, 0-3). The Nittany Lions' rushing attack totaled just 68 yards on 31 attempts in front of a whiteout crowd of 114,419.
No. 22 Houston 35, Kansas State 16
Conner Weigman threw for 242 yards and four touchdowns, all to Patrick Overmyer, as the Cougars cruised to a victory over the Wildcats in a Big 12 game in Manhattan, Kan.
Overmyer caught eight passes for 83 yards, including touchdowns of 1, 2, 8 and 2 yards. Makhi Hughes rushed for 78 yards and a score, and Re'Shaun Sanford II added 90 yards on the ground for Houston (5-1, 2-1 Big 12), which led 28-3 early in the third quarter.
For the Wildcats (3-2, 0-2), Avery Johnson completed 16 of 30 passes for 182 yards, two touchdowns and one interception. Garrett Oakley and Jaron Tibbs each caught a touchdown pass.
No. 23 Boise State 38, Fresno State 31
Dylan Riley recorded 214 scrimmage yards and accounted for two touchdowns as the Broncos won their fifth consecutive game by topping the Bulldogs in Pac-12 play at Fresno, Calif.
Riley entered the day as the national leader in rushing yards and he gained 150 on the ground to raise his total to 835 and added 64 yards on four receptions. Riley scored on a 72-yard run and a 44-yard pass play. Maddux Madsen completed 23 of 34 passes for 238 yards and two touchdowns for Boise State (5-1, 2-0 Pac 12), which had lost its previous three meetings with Fresno State. Sire Gaines rushed for 120 yards and a touchdown.
Jayden Mandal was 19-of-33 passing for 218 yards and two touchdowns and also rushed for a score for the Bulldogs (4-2, 1-1), who had a four-game winning streak halted. Ezekiel Avit caught six passes for 96 yards and two touchdowns -- one from Khristian Martin -- and Gavin Correia also had a scoring reception.
North Carolina 21, No. 25 Pitt 17
Billy Edwards Jr. threw for two touchdowns as the Tar Heels recorded the upset of the Panthers in an Atlantic Coast Conference game in Pittsburgh, giving second-year coach Bill Belichick his first victory against a ranked team.
Edwards completed 18 of 26 passes for 249 yards and two interceptions. The Tar Heels' (3-2, 1-1 Atlantic Coast Conference) go-ahead touchdown came on Edwards' 75-yard touchdown pass play to Shamar Easter with 12:36 remaining in the game.
La'Vell Wright ran for two touchdowns for Pitt (5-1, 2-1). Holden Geriner was 27-for-44 passing for 219 yards, with two interceptions, in his first start following a season-ending knee injury suffered by Mason Heintschel a week earlier.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Nico Hischier scores milestone goal, leads Devils past Canucks
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Nico Hischier scored twice on the power play, including his 200th career goal, and the New Jersey Devils rallied to beat the Vancouver Canucks 4-1 on Saturday afternoon in Newark, N.J.
items.body:
Nico Hischier scored twice on the power play, including his 200th career goal, and the New Jersey Devils rallied to beat the Vancouver Canucks 4-1 on Saturday afternoon in Newark, N.J.
Jake Allen made 20 saves in his 500th career game to get the win as New Jersey snapped a two-game losing skid.
Jesper Bratt had a goal and an assist, Jesper Boqvist also scored and Jack Hughes had two assists for the Devils, who finished with three goals on the power play to claim their second win of the season. Hischier, who signed a five-year, $58.5 million deal in the offseason, also had an assist.
Linus Karlsson had a goal while Leevi Merilainen and Kevin Lankinen combined to stop 33 shots for the Canucks, who suffered their third consecutive loss.
Paul Cotter, the NHL's Third Star of the Week, was held pointless in his first game with the Canucks against his former team.
The teams traded power-play goals to open the scoring in the first period.
Karlsson gave the Canucks a 1-0 lead with a power play goal on a one-timer after taking a pass from Brock Boeser.
Hischier busted out of an early slump to score his first point of the season and 200th goal to tie it 1-1 with Vancouver forward Jonathan Lekkerimaki off for high-sticking.
The Devils then recorded their first regulation lead of the season by capitalizing on a Canucks miscue in the Vancouver zone. Amadeus Lombardi stole the puck from Canucks defenseman Filip Hronek, then took a shot that generated a rebound which was poked in by forward Boqvist to make it 2-1 at 16:24 of the first period.
Boqvist's goal came against Lankinen, who entered the game after starter Merilainen sustained an equipment malfunction when his skate blade fell out. Merilainen left the game with 5:27 remaining in the first and returned for the start of the second period.
Bratt took advantage of a mad scramble in the Canucks' crease early in the second, scoring on the power play from a sharp angle with a shot that ricocheted off a couple Vancouver players into the net to give the Devils a two-goal lead.
Hischier finished off a tic-tac-toe passing play for his second power play goal with just 10 seconds left in the second to make it 4-1.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Une nouvelle attaque contre l'aéroport de Ryad fait douze morts, selon des sources
items.author: Timour Azhari, Enas Alashray
items.creator: Timour Azhari, Enas Alashray
items.summary: Une attaque contre l'aéroport de Ryad a fait douze morts et des dizaines de blessés samedi, selon trois sources au fait du dossier, tandis que tous les vols ont été déroutés.
items.body:
Une attaque contre l'aéroport de Ryad a fait douze morts et des dizaines de blessés samedi, selon trois sources au fait du dossier, tandis que tous les vols ont été déroutés.
Cette attaque n'a pas été revendiquée dans l'immédiat mais elle intervient dans le contexte d'une intensification des frappes de missiles menées par les Houthis du Yémen, alliés de l'Iran, contre l'Arabie saoudite.
L'aéroport de Ryad a déjà été visé à deux reprises la semaine passée par des attaques qui ont fait quatre morts et plusieurs blessés, endommageant également un avion de la compagnie Saudia.
Le bureau des médias du gouvernement saoudien n'a pas répondu dans l'immédiat aux demandes de commentaires relatives à celle de samedi, pour laquelle le système d'alerte précoce n'a émis aucun avertissement.
Aucun bilan officiel n'a été fourni.
Les sources, dont deux sont des responsables occidentaux, ont prévenu que le nombre de victimes pourrait encore changer. Les blessés, dont certains sont dans un état grave, ont été transportés à l'hôpital, ont-elles indiqué.
Un témoin présent à l'aéroport a dit avoir vu une explosion puis de nombreuses personnes blessées allongées au sol à l'intérieur de l'aéroport. Plus d'une douzaine d'ambulances ont été vues en train de se diriger à vive allure vers les lieux de l'attaque.
Un voyageur blessé a pour sa part indiqué à Reuters avoir vu un objet traverser le ciel à l'extérieur de l'aéroport avant qu'une partie du plafond, près d'une porte d'embarquement, ne s'effondre.
Le président américain Donald Trump, interrogé par des journalistes à la Maison blanche sur une éventuelle participation des États-Unis à des frappes saoudiennes contre les Houthis, a par la suite déclaré : "C'est possible. Nous allons examiner cette question. Nous venons juste d'apprendre cette récente attaque, nous prendrons donc une décision. Nous agissons très rapidement."
L'ambassade des États-Unis à Ryad a indiqué être "au courant des attaques" et a "vivement recommandé à tous les citoyens américains d'éviter cet aéroport et les zones environnantes".
"INCIDENT GRAVE" Les ambassades du Royaume-Uni et d'Irlande en Arabie saoudite ont de leur côté déclaré sur X qu'elles étaient également informées d'un "incident grave", tandis que celle du Canada a indiqué que des "activités militaires en cours" perturbaient les opérations aéroportuaires.
Selon le site de suivi du trafic aérien Flightradar24, tous les vols à destination de Ryad ont été soit déroutés, soit annulés.
Kuwait Airways a indiqué avoir annulé ses vols à destination et en provenance de la capitale saoudienne, invoquant une fermeture de l'aéroport de Ryad due à la "situation sécuritaire".
Etihad Airways et Qatar Airways avaient auparavant annulé plusieurs vols entre leurs hubs respectifs et Ryad, certaines annulations étant maintenues jusqu'à lundi.
Les assauts houthistes de la semaine passée avaient déjà conduit plusieurs compagnies aériennes à suspendre ou à annuler leurs liaisons vers la capitale saoudienne, peu avant la tenue à Ryad d'importantes conférences consacrées à l'énergie et à l'investissement.
Les organisateurs de ces conférences ont indiqué samedi qu'elles se dérouleraient comme prévu et tenté de rassurer les participants quant à leur sécurité.
Les Houthis ont déclaré que les compagnies aériennes devaient éviter l'espace aérien saoudien, qu'ils ont qualifié de zone d'opérations militaires après le lancement, plus tôt ce mois-ci, d'une offensive contre le groupe par le gouvernement yéménite soutenu par l'Arabie saoudite.

items.title: Inter rout Parma, De Bruyne double lifts Napoli
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Inter Milan maintained their strong start to the Serie A campaign with a comfortable 3-0 home victory over Parma on Saturday, while two goals from Kevin De Bruyne eased Napoli to a 3-0 home win against Frosinone following the international break.
items.body:
Inter Milan maintained their strong start to the Serie A campaign with a comfortable 3-0 home victory over Parma on Saturday, while two goals from Kevin De Bruyne eased Napoli to a 3-0 home win against Frosinone following the international break.
First-half goals from Petar Sucic, Hakan Calhanoglu, who converted a penalty, and Marcus Thuram put the champions firmly in control inside the opening 31 minutes. The result lifted leaders Inter to 16 points from six matches.
“After a three-week break, we didn’t know how things would go. We’ve worked well during this period, the players have trained well. I’m happy,” Inter head coach Cristian Chivu told DAZN.
The defeat marked a difficult first game in charge for Parma coach Alberto Gilardino, [USN:L6N45L0WD TEXT:"who succeeded"] Carlos Cuesta following his departure in late September.
“I think you always have to be clear-headed at different moments of the game, depending on who you’re playing against and what you’re up against. The overall picture tonight is that Parma started well, but when you are naive, you pay the price,” Gilardino said.
MCTOMINAY RETURNS FOR NAPOLI In Naples, Scott McTominay was named among the substitutes after recovering from a heart problem as Napoli overcame a sluggish start to beat Frosinone.
Napoli were awarded a penalty in the 29th minute and after Rasmus Hojlund's spot kick was saved by Lorenzo Palmisani, the effort was ordered to be retaken as the goalkeeper was ruled to have moved off his line.
Kevin De Bruyne converted the second attempt before Noa Lang doubled Napoli's lead three minutes later.
McTominay made his return just after the hour mark to a standing ovation from the home crowd, although he was unable to influence the contest.
De Bruyne wrapped up the victory late on, finishing from close range for his second goal of the evening.
The win provided a much needed boost to Napoli as they had suffered two defeats and a draw in their previous five matches. They moved to sixth place with 10 points.
"We had to win," De Bruyne told Sky. "It's a very difficult schedule, but we have to move forward and do our best."
Second placed AS Roma and Lazio, who are both on 13 points, will be in action on Sunday. Roma visit Como, while Lazio host Monza.
Surprise package Cagliari, fourth on 12 points, face a tough home test against Juventus on Sunday.

items.title: PSG beat Le Mans 3-1 as Monaco stay top despite draw
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Paris St Germain's Maghnes Akliouche scored his first goal for the club as the champions eased to a 3-1 home victory over Le Mans in Ligue 1 on Saturday, while league leaders AS Monaco were held to a frustrating 2-2 draw by visiting Toulouse.
items.body:
Paris St Germain's Maghnes Akliouche scored his first goal for the club as the champions eased to a 3-1 home victory over Le Mans in Ligue 1 on Saturday, while league leaders AS Monaco were held to a frustrating 2-2 draw by visiting Toulouse.
The game was played in a tense atmosphere as, amid student protests across France, a banner was unfurled at the stadium which read: "Your riot police repress, our youth resists."
Scuffles broke out as police tried to remove the banner and eventually the entire stand was temporarily emptied of spectators.
PSG took the lead with a penalty converted by Lucas Beraldo, but Le Mans levelled in the second half through Louis Mafouta who blasted home for his fourth Ligue 1 goal this season.
Home coach Luis Enrique reacted by making four substitutions at once just before the hour mark and one of those, Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, fired them ahead two minutes after coming on as he reacted quickest to a rebound.
Akliouche then ended the game as a contest with the third, his first goal since switching from Monaco at the start of the season.
PSG were awarded a penalty in added time but Desire Doue’s effort was saved by goalkeeper Nicolas Kocik.
The win leaves PSG in fifth on 11 points after six games.
Monaco let a 2-0 first-half lead slip as they were held by Toulouse. They have 14 points and a one-point lead over Lille.
Edan Diop scored their opener and then turned provider for Matthis Abline to net his first Monaco goal since a move from Nantes.
Casper Tengstedt pulled one back for the visitors with a penalty just after the break before teenager Sion Oppong netted his first Toulouse goal to make it 2-2.
Lille briefly moved top as they won 1-0 at home to 10-man Le Havre before being leapfrogged later on by Monaco.
Dilane Bakwa scored the winner in the fifth minute but Lille were run close by Le Havre, who lost Ayumu Seko to a red card for a professional foul just past the hour mark.
Paris FC remain fourth despite a 1-0 loss at Lorient and sit above local rivals PSG on goal difference.
They had more of the ball but Lorient took their chance as Gabin Bernardeau netted after 68 minutes.
Brest scored four first-half goals before eventually running out 5-1 victors over 10-man Angers in a one-sided contest.
Ludovic Ajorque, Lucas Tousart, Kenny Lala, Mama Balde and Pathe Mboup scored for Brest, while Prosper Peter netted a consolation for the visitors, who had Jordan Lefort sent off after 59 minutes.

items.title: El sushi se sirve con espectáculo: restaurantes despiezan atunes gigantes frente a sus clientes
items.author: Alina Dizik
items.summary: Algunos restaurantes de sushi han comenzado a ofrecer cenas alrededor del despiece de atunes de 90 kilos. Los clientes prueban distintas partes del pescado mientras observan el trabajo del chef.
items.body: Bloomberg — La reciente cena de Raquel Livingston en el restaurante Koete Omakase de Nueva York no se pareció en nada a la mayoría de sus salidas habituales para degustar comida japonesa. Para empezar, afirma, le pareció más bien una “clase de biología con una deliciosa recompensa”. Ver más: Los supermercados aprovechan la sobreoferta para vender vinos premium más baratos Esta ingeniera de software asistió a una cena de US$ 218 en la que el chef despiezó un atún entero. Le sorprendió lo mucho que aprendió: el restaurante repartió un folleto con un diagrama para destacar los cortes más exclusivos. Livingston se llevó a casa aún más atún fresco, suficiente para dos cenas más. Al tercer día, “resultaba un poco abrumador”, afirma. Aun así, ella y su novio disfrutaron de los rollitos que prepararon esa noche. Restaurantes de sushi como Koete están sustituyendo la música suave y el pescado cuidadosamente emplatado por el sangriento espectáculo de despiezar un atún rojo de 200 libras delante de los clientes que han pagado por ello. Algunos cobran sumas que superan con creces las cinco cifras por reservar el restaurante en exclusiva para toda la noche. En las noches de despiece, los comensales pueden observar de cerca el proceso y pueden llegar a comer más de una libra de pescado de una sola vez. Desmembrar un atún entero de esta manera suele ser más caótico que lo que ocurre en las noches normales, afirma Ayana Chen, copropietaria de Koete junto con su madre y que comenzó a organizar estos eventos este año. “Es un poco más laborioso”, añade. En Koete, los entendidos en atún tienen acceso a cortes que rara vez se encuentran disponibles, incluida la carne de las mejillas, la frente, la zona cercana a las branquias y el cuello del atún. Incluso los cortes tradicionales saben mejor cuando el pescado se corta fresco. “Todo el chutoro se derrite en la boca”, afirma Livingston refiriéndose al atún de grasa media. Otros comensales pueden raspar la carne fresca de la espina dorsal y las costillas. Chen afirma que el atún es lo que atrae a los comensales (y a las cámaras de sus teléfonos) al local: las degustaciones de atún ya tienen lista de espera. También es una forma de competir con otros restaurantes de omakase sin tener que bajar los precios. En Japón se lleva mucho tiempo ofreciendo demostraciones de corte de atún con carácter de espectáculo en eventos y restaurantes, mientras que el procesamiento habitual se lleva a cabo en lugares como el mercado de Toyosu, sin acceso al público, explica Kenji Hiraoka, con sede en Tokio y director general de Origami Concierge, una agencia de viajes. En Estados Unidos, los supermercados —a menudo especializados en cocina asiática— han organizado demostraciones de corte de atún para mostrar el pescado fresco y atraer a los clientes. Nick DiGiovanni, un youtuber famoso por sus acrobacias culinarias, también ha colaborado en el despiece de un atún entero en Japón. Sin embargo, en los últimos años, los restaurantes estadounidenses de gama alta han comenzado a ofrecer estos elaborados eventos. Pocos restaurantes encargan atún rojo entero debido a los problemas logísticos, afirma Sang Won Lee, responsable de la división central de compras de True World Foods, un distribuidor de productos del mar con sede en Rockleigh, Nueva Jersey. El distribuidor vende los cortes a un precio de entre US$25 y US$30 la libra, frente a los US$15 a US$20 por libra que cuesta el pescado entero. A pesar de que el precio por libra es más bajo, la mayoría de los restaurantes no disponen del personal ni de las neveras gigantes necesarias para trocear y almacenar el pescado de seis pies de largo, que puede aportar un 15% más de carne aprovechable que si se comprara completamente limpio y con la cabeza intacta. Además, se requiere una formación especializada para conservar partes valiosas como la ventresca. “Es una gran cantidad de pescado para un restaurante, lo que hace prácticamente imposible que los restaurantes aprovechen todo el pescado de forma eficaz”, afirma Lee. El atún rojo que llega a Estados Unidos procede de México y España, y parte de él procede de países ribereños del mar Adriático, entre ellos Croacia, añade. En algunos casos, el atún que se encuentra en la tabla de cortar no siempre es el mismo que el que llega al plato. No fue hasta que ya había dado un bocado cuando Rachel Cervantes se dio cuenta de que no estaba degustando el pescado que aún se estaba troceando delante de ella durante su visita a Le Coq, un restaurante de cocina fusión situado en La Jolla, California. Cervantes, que se enteró del evento ‘Tuna Thursday’ a través de Instagram y pagó US$65 más propina por la cena y el espectáculo, disfrutó de todos modos del ambiente, pero comer pescado cortado antes del evento le pareció algo teatral. “Hubiera estado bien que fuera, literalmente, de la granja a la mesa, del pescado directamente a la boca”, afirma esta ejecutiva del sector biotecnológico afincada en San Diego. El restaurante no podría satisfacer la demanda si el pescado se sirviera en tiempo real, afirma Lillian Dang, directora de marketing de Puffer Malarkey Collective, propietaria de Le Coq: “Se trata de una experiencia y un punto de conexión, no de afirmar que los comensales estén comiendo ese pescado concreto”. Existe un contexto histórico que justifica el alarde del manejo del cuchillo y las habilidades de trinchado de un chef. Es probable que esta práctica se iniciara a finales del siglo IX en Japón y que incluyera carpas y aves silvestres para demostrar la destreza culinaria del chef, afirma Takeshi Watanabe, profesor asociado de Estudios de Asia Oriental en la Universidad de Wesleyan. En Japón, el toro, o atún graso, no se convirtió en un alimento popular hasta después de la Segunda Guerra Mundial. “Existe una gran diferencia entre esto y el modelo histórico”, afirma. En el pasado, la atención se centraba en el trinchado ritual de diversos animales, más que en un ingrediente concreto. En las últimas dos décadas, cada vez más supermercados y cadenas de sushi japonesas han ofrecido espectáculos de carácter lúdico, y se ha creado una asociación profesional de trinchado de atún con sede en Japón, añade Hiraoka, de Origami Concierge. El Omakase Kyara Sake Bar de Las Vegas comenzó a ofrecer un corte de atún entero en 2023 y ahora organiza uno cada mes. El chef y propietario, Winston Matsuuchi, afirma que el corte de atún atrae a los turistas lejos de los restaurantes de los hoteles de lujo del Strip y los lleva a su local, situado en el barrio de Spring Valley. Los beneficios de la velada, en la que las entradas oscilan entre los US$200 y los US$400 por persona, requieren más preparación, pero equivalen a lo que el restaurante ingresa en una noche típica de fin de semana. El precio incluye toda la comida, y las entradas más caras incluyen chupitos de tuétano coronados con erizo de mar y una pizca de caviar. Esos comensales se sientan más cerca de la zona de despiece. El evento “no es excesivamente lucrativo” debido a que se necesitan unas diez personas para despiezar el pescado en menos de una hora, afirma. “Hay mucha presión de tiempo: todo el mundo está sudando y cortando”. Han Jeon, director jefe de marketing de Omakase Shoji e Izakaya en Chicago, comenzó a ofrecer este año la posibilidad de reservar el restaurante en exclusiva para un evento de corte de atún. Un puñado de empresas, principalmente destacadas firmas tecnológicas, han dado el paso, adquiriendo el pescado y sus acompañamientos por unos US$30.000 para grupos de entre 30 y 40 personas. El restaurante no se plantea organizar un evento periódico abierto al público. “Es un gasto considerable”, afirma Jeon. El coste del atún y del transporte puede suponer más del 50% del precio de la reserva. Omakase Shoji colabora con mayoristas con sede en Japón para pujar por el pescado en el mercado de Tokio sin intermediarios. Una vez despiezado el atún, el chef ofrece a los comensales cortes poco habituales, como el chiai, una carne oscura situada a lo largo de la espina dorsal. En Japón se consume, pero en Estados Unidos suele desecharse. Cortada en cubitos y mezclada con una salsa a base de soja, se dice que tiene un sabor más sabroso, casi similar al del foie gras, explica Jeon. El ambiente más distendido “se aleja de nuestro omakase habitual”, añade. Quienes repiten dicen que no se trata solo del pescado. Michael McPhilomy, de Jacksonville (Florida), es un aficionado al atún crudo. Ha asistido a unas 15 sesiones de despiece en Kyara cuando viaja a Las Vegas y disfruta del ambiente festivo y de estar cerca de la acción. “El atún en sí es enorme”, afirma. “La gente aplaude y hay oportunidades para hacerse fotos con el pescado”. McPhilomy, un jefe de proyectos que trabaja en el sector de la construcción, no duda en recomendar uno de los rituales más animados, en el que el chef vierte sake a través de la cabeza del atún directamente en la boca del comensal. Y siempre advierte a quienes acuden por primera vez: “Es posible que se manche un poco”. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: Un tiroteo masivo deja nueve muertos en Erie, en Estados Unidos
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Las autoridades confirmaron la muerte de nueve personas en Erie, en el estado de Pensilvania, en Estados Unidos, tras lo que el gobernador Josh Shapiro calificó como un "trágico tiroteo masivo".
items.body:
Las autoridades confirmaron la muerte de nueve personas en Erie, en el estado de Pensilvania, en Estados Unidos, tras lo que el gobernador Josh Shapiro calificó como un "trágico tiroteo masivo".
El incidente tuvo lugar a última hora del viernes y los investigadores determinaron que todas las muertes ocurrieron antes de que los agentes llegaran al lugar de los hechos, según un comunicado del Ayuntamiento de Erie el sábado.
"He hablado con la alcaldesa Devlin y le he ofrecido todo el apoyo de mi gobierno tras el trágico tiroteo masivo ocurrido anoche en Erie, en el que perdieron la vida nueve de nuestros conciudadanos de Pensilvania", escribió Shapiro en una publicación del sábado por la mañana en X, refiriéndose a la alcaldesa Daria Devlin.
El jefe de policía de Erie, Rick Lorah, dijo en un comunicado tras el tiroteo que la escena era una de las más difíciles a las que se había enfrentado durante su gestion.
"La pérdida de vidas humanas es devastadora, y las circunstancias a las que nos enfrentamos son profundamente inquietantes", agregó.
Lorah añadió que las autoridades seguían trabajando para determinar el motivo. El ayuntamiento indicó que estaba prevista una rueda de prensa para el sábado.

items.title: サウジの空港に再び攻撃、12人死亡・300人超負傷　フーシ派が閉鎖表明
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Timour Azhari　Enas Alashray

［リヤド　１０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Timour Azhari　Enas Alashray

［リヤド　１０日　ロイター］ - サウジアラビアのリヤドにあるキング・ハーリド国際空港が１０日に攻撃を受け、同国当局によると、少なくとも１２人が死亡、３００人以上が負傷した。イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派が攻撃を認めた。同空港が攻撃されるのは今週３回目。サウジへの攻撃は一段と激しさを増している。

サウジ民間航空当局によると、死者はサウジアラビア人４人、バングラデシュ人２人のほか、米国、ヨルダン、パレスチナ、シリア、スーダン、エジプトの出身者各１人。負傷者は最新の集計で３０９人まで増えた。事情を知る関係者によると、負傷者は救急車やヘリコプターで搬送され、病院は対応に追われた。一部は重体という。

今回の攻撃は事前の警告なく発生し、早期警戒システムの警報も出ていなかった。同空港は今週既に２度攻撃を受け、４人が死亡したほか、駐機中のサウジの民間旅客機が大きく損傷した。相次ぐ攻撃で多数の死者が出たことで、サウジの防衛能力の脆弱性が浮き彫りとなった。

フーシ派の広報部門トップは攻撃後にＸへ投稿し、「リヤド国際空港を閉鎖した」と表明した。フーシ派は、サウジの支援を受けるイエメン政府が５日にフーシ派への攻勢を開始したことを受け、サウジ領空を軍事作戦区域に指定し、民間航空機に同領空を避けるよう警告している。

サウジ主導のアラブ諸国連合軍は今回の攻撃に報復すると表明した。

２０１５年にイエメン内戦に介入したサウジは、フーシ派と地上戦を展開するイエメン政府を支援するため、フーシ派への空爆を続けている。サウジとイエメン政府は、フーシ派支配地域の標的に数百回の攻撃を行ったとしている。フーシ派は、これらの攻撃で女性や子どもを含む民間人が死亡したとしている。ロイターは双方の主張を独自に確認できていない。

今回の攻撃後、トランプ米大統領はホワイトハウスの外で記者団の取材に応じた。米国がサウジによるフーシ派への攻撃に加わる計画があるかと問われ、「そうするかもしれない。検討する。今回の攻撃について知ったばかりだ。決定を下すことになる。われわれは非常に迅速に動く」と述べた。

ルビオ米国務長官は攻撃を非難し、「罪のない民間人の命をあからさまに軽視する行為だ」と述べた。

在リヤド米大使館は「攻撃を把握している」とし、「全ての米国民に対し、同空港と周辺地域を避けるよう強く勧告する」と表明した。在サウジの英国大使館とアイルランド大使館もＸへの投稿で、同空港での「重大な事案」を把握していると明らかにした。カナダ大使館は「進行中の軍事活動」が空港の運営に影響を及ぼしていると説明した。

空港にいた目撃者によると、爆発が起き、その後、屋内で複数の人が負傷して倒れていた。負傷した旅行者はロイターに対し、空港の外で何かが上空を飛んでいくのを見た後、出発ゲート付近の天井の一部が崩落したと語った。

＜リヤドで大型国際会議＞

サウジ民間航空当局によると、リヤドに向かう全便が目的地を変更し、空港の業務は一時停止した。

航空機追跡サイト「フライトレーダー２４」によると、リヤド行きの全便が目的地変更か欠航となった。エティハド航空とカタール航空は、それぞれの拠点空港とリヤドを結ぶ複数の便を欠航にした。一部の欠航は１２日まで続く。クウェート航空も、リヤド空港が「治安情勢」を理由に閉鎖されたとして、リヤド発着便を欠航にしたと発表した。

リヤドでは今月、世界石油会議（ＷＰＣ）とサウジアラビアの政府系ファンド、パブリック・インベストメント・ファンド（ＰＩＦ）が主導する国際金融会議 「未来投資イニシアチブ（ＦＩＩ）」が開かれる。両会議の主催者は１０日、予定通り開催すると表明し、参加者の安全への懸念払拭に努めた

items.title: Bruins score 3 goals in final period, keep Flyers winless
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Capping a three-point effort, Fraser Minten's second goal of the season concluded a three-goal third period for the Boston Bruins in a 5-1 win over the visiting Philadelphia Flyers on Saturday afternoon.
items.body:
Capping a three-point effort, Fraser Minten's second goal of the season concluded a three-goal third period for the Boston Bruins in a 5-1 win over the visiting Philadelphia Flyers on Saturday afternoon.
Pavel Zacha and Mason Lohrei scored to give Boston leads after the first two periods before the emphatic finish. Marat Khusnutdinov and Casey Mittelstadt also lit the lamp, while Minten and JJ Peterka each had two assists.
Jeremy Swayman made 14 saves en route to the Bruins' second straight win and fourth through their first six games.
Boston finished with a 32-15 shots on goal advantage.
Porter Martone scored a power-play goal and Dan Vladar (27 saves) took the loss for Philadelphia, which remains winless at 0-4-2 on the season. The Flyers were missing forward Travis Konecny (lower-body) and defenseman Cam York (upper-body) due to day-to-day injuries.
Zacha's first goal of the season at the 12:24 mark punctuated a dominant opening period in which Boston held a 12-3 edge in shots, including holding Philadelphia without a chance during its first power play.
Less than one minute after the Bruins completed a solid kill, David Pastrnak moved into the zone off a turnover at the blue line and dropped a backhand pass for Zacha, whose shot from the high slot leaked through Vladar and dribbled over the goal line for the opening tally.
The visitors went without a shot for more than half of the second period, but Swayman stood up to the task of Martone's driving backhander with 9:51 to go.
Lohrei doubled Boston's lead with 2:48 left in the middle frame. After Swayman's save on a David Jiricek point shot created an odd-man rush, Minten started the play and Peterka fed the trailing defenseman for a top-shelf wrister coming to the top of the circles.
The Bruins needed only 1:55 of third-period time to make it a 3-0 game, as Khusnutdinov slammed home Minten's pass from behind the net following a crisp sequence between the duo and defenseman Will Borgen.
Martone broke the shutout at 6:32, placing a tight-angle wrister from the left circle upstairs on Swayman.
At 9:21, Boston regained its three-goal advantage after Casey Mittelstadt joined Lohrei with his second goal in as many games. After James Hagens had an initial shot saved by Vladar, he made a diagonal pass to Elias Lindholm in the bottom of the right circle, and Mittelstadt buried it in front.
Minten put the exclamation point on the victory with 4:01 to go, speeding past a defender and down the left side to slip a quick shot five-hole on Vladar.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Spurs show fight as United's struggles deepen at Old Trafford
items.author: Lori Ewing
items.creator: Lori Ewing
items.summary: While Tottenham Hotspur have plenty to rue amid a difficult opening to the season, manager Roberto De Zerbi saw something at Old Trafford on Saturday that gave him reason to believe his struggling side may finally be turning a corner.
items.body:
While Tottenham Hotspur have plenty to rue amid a difficult opening to the season, manager Roberto De Zerbi saw something at Old Trafford on Saturday that gave him reason to believe his struggling side may finally be turning a corner.
Spurs are 18th and without a victory after six Premier League games following Saturday's 1-1 draw at Manchester United, yet De Zerbi was heartened by the fight his team showed to thoroughly dominate the game and then snatch a stoppage-time equaliser through Dominic Solanke despite being reduced to 10 men.
"I am very happy because I have seen the right spirit and character," De Zerbi told Sky Sports.
Bryan Mbeumo scored against the run of play before Tottenham's Rodrigo Bentancur was sent off for head-butting Luke Shaw, leaving United fans daring to dream of a much-needed victory, only for Solanke's 92nd-minute header to puncture the mood at Old Trafford.
"We suffered in the game. I like the situation we were in with the red card. We need this situation. We have not accepted the defeat. We have to react in all ways we can," De Zerbi said.
Rather than fold, Tottenham fought until Solanke headed the equaliser in stoppage time, giving De Zerbi's side more to celebrate than their hosts despite their lowly league position.
Spurs, who spent more than £300 million ($397 million) in the transfer market during the close season, have failed to win any of their opening six league matches for only the fourth time in the club's history.
Their manager, however, believes there were signs against United that his ideas are beginning to take hold.
"We have to believe in ourselves and this football way," De Zerbi said. "If we believe, improve and play as a team, we will score many goals and win many games. If we don't play as a team, it is impossible."
For United, there was less cause for optimism.
Michael Carrick's side have collected only six points from their first six games, their poorest start to a league campaign since 1986-87, when they had four at the same stage.
United struggled desperately before taking the lead through Mbeumo. But even with a man advantage, they failed to put away a Tottenham team that had started the day bottom of the table.
"We were mixed (in performance)," Carrick said. "We found it tough first half, it was a challenging first half for us and you could see it just wasn't quite there, it wasn't clicking."
The Reds are also winless in the last three league matches when their opponent has had a red card.
Carrick was particularly frustrated at allowing Tottenham back into the game that appeared to be United's for the taking.
"It's a game we should kill off. And we didn't," he said. "Very disappointed to be in a position like that and not come away with the game."
($1 = 0.7558 pounds)

items.title: 茂木外相がルビオ米国務長官と電話会談、ＩＣＣ制裁で「意思疎通を継続」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Tamiyuki Kihara

［東京／ワシントン　１０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Tamiyuki Kihara

［東京／ワシントン　１０日　ロイター］ - 茂木敏充外相は１０日夜、米国のルビオ国務長官と電話会談し、トランプ米政権が国際刑事裁判所（ＩＣＣ）本体に制裁措置を科したことについて、緊密に意思疎通を継続することで一致した。茂木氏はこれに先立ち、ＩＣＣの赤根智子所長とも電話で会談した。

日本外務省によると、茂木氏はＩＣＣについてルビオ氏に「これまで表明している日本の立場」（外務省関係者）を改めて伝達。両氏は緊密に意思疎通を継続していくことで一致した。厳しい安全保障環境の中で日米同盟をさらに強固なものにし、幅広く協力を進めていくために引き続き取り組むことも確認した。

このほか、沖縄県で発生した強盗殺人事件で米兵が逮捕されたことについても「事件の発生防止のために実効性のある措置を取るべく、日米間で協議していくこと」を確認した。赤根氏との電話会談では、ＩＣＣを巡る現下の状況などについて意見交換したという。

米国務省は声明で、日米外相が電話会談で、ＩＣＣへの制裁や３０─３１日に米アトランタで開催される２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）外相会合などについて意見交換したと発表した。沖縄県で発生した強盗殺人事件については、 「ルビオ氏は沖縄での日本国民の死去に心からの哀悼の意を示すとともに、日本政府と地元当局が捜査を進めるに当たり、連絡を取り合い全面的に協力するという米国の決意を伝えた」とした。

日本や英国など複数の欧州諸国、カナダの外相は９日、トランプ米政権がＩＣＣ本体に制裁措置を科したことを受け、「制裁が実施されれば、ＩＣＣの活動、献身的な職員、その家族に重大な影響を及ぼすことになる」などとする共同声明を発表した。

高市早苗首相も同日夜、米国の制裁が「日本の立場と相容れるものではなく、深く懸念している」と自身のソーシャルメディア「Ｘ」に投稿。「我が国は国際社会における法の支配を一貫して重視し、その役割を担うＩＣＣを支持している」とも改めて表明した。

ノルウェーに本拠地を置くノーベル賞委員会は同日、ＩＣＣで判事を務めたナビ・ピレイ氏にノーベル平和賞を授与すると発表した。これを受け、トランプ米大統領は自身が受賞できなかったことに不満を表明。恥ずべき不名誉な決定でノルウェーに汚点を残したなどと批判していた。

（鬼原民幸　編集：平田紀之）

items.title: El huracán Isaías se cobra cuatro vidas y deja a unos 670.000 personas sin electricidad en EEUU
items.author: Rhea Abraham, Rajveer Pardesi, Marianna Parraga
items.creator: Rhea Abraham, Rajveer Pardesi, Marianna Parraga
items.summary: Cuatro personas fallecieron tras la llegada del huracán Isaías a primera hora del sábado, y unos 670.000 habitantes de Florida, Alabama, Georgia y Misisipi seguían sin suministro eléctrico cuando la tormenta se debilitó hasta convertirse en un ciclón postropical, según autoridades locales y los servicios de seguimiento del suministro eléctrico en Estados Unidos.
items.body:
Cuatro personas fallecieron tras la llegada del huracán Isaías a primera hora del sábado, y unos 670.000 habitantes de Florida, Alabama, Georgia y Misisipi seguían sin suministro eléctrico cuando la tormenta se debilitó hasta convertirse en un ciclón postropical, según autoridades locales y los servicios de seguimiento del suministro eléctrico en Estados Unidos.
Dos de las muertes se debieron a la caída de árboles sobre viviendas, según medios de comunicación locales y las autoridades.
Las autoridades de Florida no habían recibido ninguna solicitud de búsqueda y rescate poco después de que la tormenta tocó tierra, lo que indica que el impacto fue limitado, dijo el gobernador Ron DeSantis.
Sin embargo, seguían existiendo condiciones peligrosas y se esperaban marejadas ciclónicas, inundaciones repentinas, vientos destructivos y riesgo de tornados en algunas zonas del sureste de Estados Unidos, según el Centro Nacional de Huracanes (CNH).
Se prevé que la amenaza de tornados continúe el sábado en algunas zonas del Panhandle de Florida, Georgia y las Carolinas, según el NHC.
Otra tormenta en el océano Pacífico, "Rachel", se desplazaba el sábado hacia la costa del norte de Baja California, provocando ráfagas de viento y mareas más altas, lo que dejó a otras 7.000 personas sin electricidad en California.
Isaías, un huracán de categoría 2 cuando tocó tierra en la costa de Florida y el primero de la temporada atlántica de 2026, se espera que genere rachas de viento en el interior antes de debilitarse por debajo de la fuerza de vendaval más tarde el sábado, según el CNH.
Alrededor del 69% de la producción de petróleo y el 57% de la de gas natural en el golfo de México estadounidense seguían paralizados el sábado, lo que supone un ligero descenso con respecto a las cifras del viernes, según la Administración de Minerales Marinos.
Unas 113 plataformas de producción, que representan el 30% del total, seguían evacuadas, según la agencia.

items.title: Nvidia in talks to invest further in Reflection AI or buy it, FT reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Nvidia is in talks to deepen its investment in open-source startup Reflection AI or acquire it, the Financial Times reported on Saturday, citing people with direct knowledge of the matter.
items.body:
Nvidia (NVDA.O) is in talks to deepen its investment in open-source startup Reflection AI or acquire it, the Financial Times reported on Saturday, citing people with direct knowledge of the matter.
Talks are at an early stage and a deal could take several forms, including a so-called acqui-hire arrangement where Nvidia would hire staff and license technology rather than pursue a full acquisition, potentially avoiding a lengthy regulatory review, the newspaper said.
An agreement could be reached in the coming weeks, according to the report, which cited multiple people familiar with the matter, while adding that the discussions could still fall apart.
Reflection declined to comment on the FT report, while Nvidia did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
Nvidia is already a major financial backer and strategic investor in Reflection AI, having invested $800 million in the startup, the FT reported.
Founded in 2024 by former DeepMind researchers Misha Laskin and Ioannis Antonoglou, Reflection develops tools that automate software development, a fast-growing use case for AI.
Reflection's chief executive, Laskin, told CNBC in April that the Nvidia-backed startup was raising fresh capital at a pre-money valuation of [USN:FWN4160Z3 TEXT:"$25 billion"].
The company on Monday launched its first open-weight model, [USN:L4N45R19C TEXT:"Beam,"] as it seeks to compete in coding and agentic tasks with lower-cost Chinese models such as DeepSeek and Kimi.

items.summary: The Athletics will continue their search for a president of baseball operations after Sam Fuld declined an offer for the position, ESPN reported Saturday.
items.body:
The Athletics will continue their search for a president of baseball operations after Sam Fuld declined an offer for the position, ESPN reported Saturday.
Fuld is the current president of business operations for the Philadelphia Phillies and will reportedly remain in the same job.
Currently playing home games in Sacramento, Calif., the A's are scheduled to move into a stadium currently under construction in Las Vegas for the 2028 season.
The A's fired general manager David Forst in August as the team limped to a 64-98 record. The franchise last had a winning season in 2021 and last made the playoffs in 2020, when the club advanced to the American League Division Series.
According to ESPN, Boston Red Sox assistant general manager Taylor Smith is a top candidate to take over as A's president of baseball operations.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Colts DE Arden Key (hamstring) lands on injured reserve
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Indianapolis Colts placed defensive end Arden Key on injured reserve Saturday with a hamstring injury.
items.body:
The Indianapolis Colts placed defensive end Arden Key on injured reserve Saturday with a hamstring injury.
Key sustained the injury during Indianapolis' 30-13 victory over the Washington Commanders last Sunday in London.
Key, 30, has recorded eight combined tackles, one forced fumble, 0.5 sacks and three quarterback hits in four starts in his first season with Indianapolis (2-2). He signed as a free agent in March.
Key has 200 combined tackles, 31 sacks, 39 tackles for loss, five forced fumbles and two fumble recoveries in 120 regular-season games (50 starts) for the Oakland/Las Vegas Raiders (2018-20), San Francisco 49ers (2021), Jacksonville Jaguars (2022), Tennessee Titans (2023-25) and Colts.
The Raiders selected Key in the third round of the 2018 NFL Draft out of LSU.
Also on Saturday, the Colts elevated wide receiver Nick Westbrook-Ikhine from the practice squad to the active roster. He has appeared in two other games this season.
--Field Level Media
